Yen Holds Decline on Hawkish Fed Outlook — The Japanese yen traded around 156.1 per dollar on Thursday after sliding for three straight sessions, pressured mainly by the dollar’s strength following the latest Federal Reserve policy decision. The US central bank raised interest rates for the first time in three years and signaled additional tightening this year to contain inflation. The Bank of Japan is also expected to raise borrowing costs on Friday, with another increase anticipated by the end of January. On the geopolitical front, oil prices eased amid hopes that Saudi Arabia can restore energy flows through its East-West pipeline. The yen had climbed to seven-month highs earlier this month on expectations of more aggressive policy tightening by the BOJ, recent joint interventions by Tokyo and Washington, and prospects for increased capital repatriation by Japanese investors.

【國產腫瘤全營養特醫食品實現“零突破”】近日，兩款適用於10歲以上腫瘤患者的特定全營養特醫食品獲批註冊，填補了該類產品國產空白，將為腫瘤患者臨床營養支援提供更多更豐富的選擇。腫瘤患者是營養不良高發人群之一。有研究資料顯示，我國每年新增腫瘤患者約500萬人，而惡性腫瘤患者營養不良發生率高達40%至80%。腫瘤本身可引起高分解代謝和慢性系統性炎症反應，加上接受抗腫瘤治療時引發的噁心、嘔吐、進食障礙，容易導致腫瘤患者營養不良，影響治療效果。臨床營養支援已成為腫瘤綜合治療不可或缺的重要組成部分。

【Huawei vice chairman Wang Tao: compute is core of Huawei AI strategy】Huawei vice chairman and rotating chairman Wang Tao said at Huawei Connect in Shanghai that compute is the core of Huawei’s AI strategy and the company will insist on monetizing hardware. Huawei will deploy a “super-node + cluster” architecture to build a domestic compute base and offer a new global alternative. It will develop an open, open-source compute ecosystem supporting native training of mainstream large models and broad multi-model deployments. The Pangu large model will be focused on product intelligence to boost Huawei’s product competitiveness. Huawei will provide flexible offline and online compute solutions to accelerate industry AI adoption, innovate diverse compute forms to push AI into endpoints and vehicles, and design next-generation communication networks around compute to deliver intelligence to individuals, households and enterprises.

【National Radio and Television Administration: Significant progress curbing nested TV fees; 15th Five-Year Plan to shift toward service and experience improvements】The State Council Information Office held a briefing on launch of the 15th Five-Year Plan in which the National Radio and Television Administration said it will accelerate high-quality development of broadcasting, television and online audio-visual services during the period. Over the past three years the administration, working with other departments, has made significant progress tackling TV 'nested' charging and complex operational practices; entering the 15th Five-Year Plan it will move from 'dual governance' toward 'dual enhancement' of service and user experience.

【ColorOS 17釋出 OPPO稱是邁向個性化主動智慧的關鍵一步】9月17日上午，OPPO開發者大會上，OPPO全新作業系統OPPO ColorOS 17正式釋出。OPPO軟體工程事業部總裁唐凱在會上表示，ColorOS 17 是OPPO個人終端邁向個性化主動智慧的關鍵一步，OPPO端側大模型、記憶共生引擎、智慧體生態三大技術底座都迎來突破。他透露，ColorOS全球活躍使用者量已突破7.7億，輻射全球超過90個國家和地區。

【中柬經貿合委會第八次會議在南寧召開】9月16日，商務部副部長鄢東與柬埔寨商業部大臣佔尼莫在廣西南寧共同主持召開中柬經濟貿易合作委員會第八次會議。雙方圍繞貿易投資一體化發展、維護多邊貿易體制、持續最佳化營商環境等共同關心的議題深入交換意見，就進一步擴大貿易投資合作、探討建立雙邊農產品貿易行業對話機制、繼續加強雙方在世貿組織等多邊框架下合作等達成廣泛共識。 鄢東表示，在兩國領導人戰略引領和親自推動下，中柬經貿關係不斷升級發展。2025年雙邊貿易額首次突破200億美元，2026年有望再創新高。中國自柬進口農產品快速增長，柬香蕉、木薯幹、龍眼、大米等產品在華市場佔有率不斷提高。中方願與柬方共同努力，發揮好現有機制作用，提升貿易投資自由化便利化水平，攜手維護多邊貿易體制和國際經貿秩序，進一步推動雙方產供鏈融合發展。 佔尼莫表示，中國連續14年為柬最大貿易伙伴，連續13年為柬最大外資來源國，歡迎中方進一步擴大自柬進口和對柬投資。希與中方進一步充分釋放自貿安排紅利，加強電子商務領域能力建設合作，推動更多柬埔寨中小企業和產品開拓中國市場。柬方願繼續採取更加開放便利的政策，為在柬中資企業營造更有吸引力的營商環境，推動雙邊經貿合作邁上新臺階。

【廣電總局：電視“套娃”收費治理顯著 “十五五”將向“雙提升”邁進】國務院新聞辦公室今天舉行“開局起步‘十五五’”系列主題新聞釋出會，國家廣播電視總局（簡稱廣電總局）有關負責人介紹“十五五”時期加快推動廣播電視和網路視聽高質量發展有關情況。會上介紹，過去三年，廣電總局堅持以人民為中心，聯合多部門持續推進電視“套娃”收費和操作複雜治理，成效顯著。進入“十五五”，將在“雙治理”基礎上，向服務和體驗“雙提升”邁進：發展以電視大屏為核心的家庭綜合智慧終端，豐富人民群眾數智生活新場景。

【華為副董事長汪濤：華為AI戰略的核心是算力】華為副董事長、輪值董事長汪濤17日在上海舉行的華為全聯接大會上介紹華為面向智慧時代的重要部署：一是華為AI戰略的核心是算力，堅持硬體變現；二是“超節點+叢集”，打造中國堅實算力底座，為世界構建新的選擇；三是構建開源開放的算力生態，支援主流大模型原生訓練、積極擁抱“百模幹態”；四是盤古大模型聚焦華為產品智慧化，增強自身產品競爭力；五是提供線下+線上的靈活算力方案，加速行業智慧化；六是創新多樣性算力，推進AI入端、上車，智慧無所不及；七是圍繞“用算”構築新一代通訊網路，把智慧傳遞給每個人、家庭和企業。（國是直通車）

【未來五年 廣電總局將重點抓好六方面工作】國務院新聞辦公室今天（17日）舉行“開局起步‘十五五’”系列主題新聞釋出會，介紹“十五五”時期加快推動廣播電視和網路視聽高質量發展有關情況。國家廣播電視總局新聞發言人、副局長何飈介紹，未來五年，廣電總局將重點抓好六個方面工作。一是深化黨的創新理論宣傳。二是推進廣電媒體系統性變革。三是最佳化廣電視聽內容供給。四是強化科技支撐賦能引領。五是健全綜合治理和安全保障體系。六是提升廣電視聽國際傳播效能。

【From errors to dangerous actions: how embodied AI can ensure safety】Robot platform PrismaX warned a ~50 kg humanoid robot powered by a lithium battery with peak output of several horsepower should be treated as heavy machinery; whether it carries AI does not change its physical risk. Mistakes or instruction misinterpretations by large models that normally produce incorrect text can, in embodied AI, become collisions, crush injuries, dropped loads or battery incidents. PrismaX says embodied AI safety requires two layers: low-level hardware limits on speed, force and range of motion plus an independent emergency stop; and high-level model controls that detect uncertainty, refuse hazardous tasks and promptly return control to humans.

【NRTA and MIIT to standardize TVs with built-in software set-top box functions】National Radio and Television Administration deputy director He Biao said on the 17th at a State Council Information Office briefing that the NRTA, together with the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, will this year develop integrated TV technical standards to embed set-top box functions in television sets as software. China Stocks Slip as US-China Talks Loom — The Shanghai Composite slipped 0.3% to 3,880 on Thursday, while the Shenzhen Component edged down 0.1% to 13,439, reversing gains from the previous session as investors turned cautious ahead of high-level US-China talks this weekend. US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent is set to meet Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng for final preparatory discussions before the September 24 summit between Presidents Donald Trump and Xi Jinping in the US. While the upcoming meetings are expected to help improve relations between the world’s two largest economies, investors remained cautious amid lingering uncertainties over tariffs, sanctions, and geopolitical tensions, including those involving Taiwan and the Middle East. On the corporate front, BYD fell 0.6% after reports that Chinese officials may include the automaker in Xi Jinping’s business delegation for his summit with Trump. Energy stocks were also among the top laggards, including PetroChina (-1.9%) and CNOOC (-2.9%).

European Gas Drops as Traders Assess Supply Outlook — European natural gas prices dropped further below €78/MWh on Thursday but were not far from a more than three-and-a-half-year high, as traders assessed the region’s gas supply outlook. Europe is heading into winter with gas storage levels among the lowest seen in two decades, with inventories standing at around 68% full, as sustained disruptions to LNG supplies from the Persian Gulf and record summer heatwaves have severely constrained efforts to replenish reserves. This has heightened concerns over supply adequacy ahead of the heating season. Strong demand from Asia and other buyers could drive more intense competition for LNG cargoes when colder weather sets in. Meanwhile, investors are watching for clearer signals on Germany’s gas purchasing plans, with any increase in buying potentially providing further support to prices amid tight global supplies.

Hong Kong Stocks Drop After Fed Rate Hike — The Hang Seng Index slipped 1.2%, or around 290 points, to 24,410 on Thursday, amid a cautious market backdrop after the US Federal Reserve raised interest rates by 25 basis points to 3.75%-4.00% and signaled the possibility of another hike later this year. The move strengthened the US dollar and pushed Treasury yields higher, potentially weighing on liquidity and rate-sensitive Hong Kong equities. The Hong Kong Monetary Authority also raised its base rate by 25 basis points to 4.25%, following the Fed's decision. However, CICC said Hong Kong stocks could experience greater volatility from renewed US monetary tightening, but the impact should be short-lived unless the Fed begins a sustained rate-increase cycle. Meanwhile, easing oil prices offered some relief as Saudi Arabia moved to restore damaged pipeline capacity. Among notable stocks, Tencent (-1.4%), AIA (-0.6%) and Xiaomi (-1.2%) declined, while Z.AI Co. (+4.2%), Kingboard Laminates (+4.9%) and Lenovo (+1.9%) rose.

【China to push deep integration of broadcast TV and online audio-visual over next five years】National Radio and Television Administration vice director He Biao said the NRTA will, over the next five years, advance deep, coordinated integration of traditional broadcast television and online audio‑visual services. The NRTA said it will consolidate and upgrade broadcast TV, innovate online audio‑visual, and drive two strategic advances: bring broadcast media fully onto the internet’s main battleground and position broadcast audio‑visual services at the center of economic and social development.

Platinum Stays Near 2-Week Lows — Platinum futures held above $1,780 an ounce but remained near two-week lows as a stronger US dollar following the Federal Reserve’s hawkish hike offset easing pressure from retreating oil prices. The Fed’s 25bp hike, its first since 2023, and projections pointing to another increase this year raised the opportunity cost of holding a non-yielding asset such as platinum. However, oil prices eased as concerns over Middle East supply disruptions moderated, with Saudi Arabia expected to restore pipeline capacity within days. Still, crude remains above $100 a barrel, keeping inflation risks in focus. Meanwhile, platinum supply remains structurally constrained, with WPIC expecting deficits to average 331,000 oz annually from 2026-2030, despite forecasting a moderate surplus in 2026. Industrial demand also remains supportive, including applications in emissions control, hydrogen and emerging AI technologies, though the shift toward BEVs poses a longer-term headwind for autocatalyst demand.

【TIMIRAOS: Long-run rate forecasts face upside risk】TIMIRAOS said two years ago, when the Fed began cutting, 10 policymakers expected the terminal rate below 3%, seven above 3% and two at 3%. In the current SEP only one policymaker expects the long-run rate below 3%, 11 expect it above 3% and six expect 3%. In 2029 projections from 17 respondents, a majority judge that to achieve 2% inflation (DISINFLATION) rates would need to be at or above 3.6% — roughly the year-long rate level prior to this week’s hike — underscoring upside risk to long-run rate estimates.

South Korean Shares Extend Gains — The benchmark KOSPI edged up to around 6,755 on Thursday, extending gains from the previous session as the Fed’s rate hike was largely priced in. The Fed raised its policy rate by 25bp to 3.75%-4.00%, its first increase since 2023, and signaled another hike could come later this year. The move widened the US-Korea rate gap to as much as 1 percentage point, although Korean authorities said its market impact should be limited as the decision was already reflected in asset prices. At the same time, easing oil prices after the US said Saudi Arabia’s damaged East-West pipeline could resume operations within days reduced inflation concerns following the recent surge in crude prices. Additionally, stabilization in global AI and semiconductor shares helped lift technology stocks after recent declines, with Samsung Electronics and SK hynix edging higher. Other gainers included KB Financial Group (2.0%), Doosan Enerbility (2.3%), Hanwha Aerospace (2.9%), and HD Hyundai Heavy Industries (6.9%).

【OpenAI披露多起AI模型目標偏離事件 涉編造資訊與繞過限制】OpenAI披露了多起此前未公開的AI模型異常行為事件，並推出一套新的跟蹤和披露框架，用於今後報告類似情況。OpenAI週三在部落格文章中表示，此前未公開的案例包括其人工智慧技術為了給出結果而隱瞞和編造資訊。OpenAI在另一份宣告中表示，此次新披露的目標偏離事件均未涉及對第三方系統的駭客攻擊或入侵。在報告中，OpenAI詳細列出了人工智慧模型為了完成任務或在評估中取得成功而出現異常行為的多個案例。其中包括編造缺失資料、試圖繞過網路限制，以及AI代理之間共享本應保密的檔案。OpenAI還介紹了一套員工主動報告此類“目標偏離”事件的機制。所謂“目標偏離”，是指人工智慧採取與人類目標不一致的行為。公司同時建立了相應的分類和處置流程。

Heating Oil Holds Near Record High — US heating oil prices held around $5.20 per gallon, remaining near their record high and leaving them about 120% higher than a year earlier amid concerns over tightening distillate markets. EIA data showed distillate inventories, including diesel and heating oil, rose by 1.6 million barrels in the week ended September 11, but remained 13% below their five-year average, underscoring continued inventory tightness. This comes amid disruptions on multiple fronts, with Middle East supply constraints compounded by Ukrainian attacks on Russian refineries and Russia’s export curbs. Some pressure eased after Saudi Arabia offered additional crude through Oman. Meanwhile, with the US harvest season underway and the winter heating season approaching, distillate demand could strengthen further, while seasonal refinery maintenance could constrain production and add pressure to already-tight supplies.

Dollar Towers on Hawkish Fed View — The dollar index held around 100.3 on Thursday following a sharp gain in the previous session, hovering at seven-week highs after the Federal Reserve raised interest rates for the first time in three years and signaled further tightening this year to contain inflation. The FOMC increased the fed funds rate by 25 basis points to 3.75%-4%, as expected, in a unanimous decision. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh also said inflation remains too high, while data released last week showed core US inflation rose more than anticipated in August. Meanwhile, President Donald called for rates to be quickly lowered to 1% or below in a social media post, though he stopped short of criticizing Warsh. Elsewhere, the Bank of England is expected to keep rates unchanged today, while the Bank of Japan is scheduled to raise rates on Friday. On the geopolitical front, oil prices eased amid hopes that Saudi Arabia can restore energy flows through its East-West pipeline.

【江西大餘通報：因高溫等應激反應 37頭生豬在運輸中死亡 未流入市場】9月16日晚，網傳大餘東進食品有限公司場內疑似出現病死豬，引發網民關注。大餘縣農業農村局聯合大餘縣公安局等部門組成調查組連夜開展調查。現將調查情況通報如下：大餘東進食品有限公司（以下簡稱東進公司）是依法登記的有限責任公司，經營範圍為生豬屠宰、牲畜屠宰、家禽屠宰等。9月16日，東進公司累計接收分宜縣金泰農業開發有限公司等5家企業運送的21車2429頭生豬，所有生豬均隨車附帶《動物檢疫證明》，源頭上沒有發現病死豬送屠宰現象。運輸中，部分生豬因高溫天氣、環境變化等產生應激反應，導致死亡37頭。東進公司將37頭死豬依法按程式交由大餘縣忠坤畜禽無害化處理中心統一進行無害化閉環處置完畢，未流入市場。大餘縣忠坤畜禽無害化處理中心為依法登記的病死畜禽無害化處理企業，由大餘縣農業農村局負責日常監管。調查組檢查了大餘縣忠坤畜禽無害化處理中心經營狀況，沒有發現違規行為。調查組今天仍將繼續檢查東進公司之前的經營行為。大餘縣農業農村局將持續加強畜禽監管工作，守牢公共衛生與食品安全底線。

Trump Eyes EU Tariffs Over Canada Plan — U.S. President Donald Trump on Wednesday threatened sweeping tariffs on the European Union or even a halt to trade if Brussels proceeds with plans to make Canada its first “associate member.” Calling Canada “a terrible trade partner,” Trump said that if he views the EU’s move as hostile, he would impose “very serious tariffs or stop trading with Europe on many things.” His remarks followed European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen’s announcement that the bloc was opening the door for Canada to join under a new category of associate membership, which does not currently exist under EU treaties and would require ratification by member states.

Australia 10Y Yield Trades Near 2011 Highs — Australia’s 10-year government bond yield traded above 5.3%, near its highest level since mid-2011, tracking a surge in global bond yields after the Federal Reserve delivered its first rate hike in three years. The Fed unanimously raised its federal funds rate by 25 basis points to 3.75%-4.00% as expected, citing elevated inflation, while updated projections showed 16 of 18 officials expect at least one more hike this year. Focus now turns to the Reserve Bank of Australia’s September 29 policy decision, with markets pricing an 85% chance of a 25bp increase from the current 4.35% rate and expectations for the cash rate to reach 4.85% by early 2027. The IMF also flagged persistent inflation and rising energy prices as risks that could require further RBA rate hikes. Meanwhile, traders continued to monitor developments in the Iran-US war and its impact on oil prices. Crude remains above $100 per barrel, although prices are easing as Saudi Arabia works to restore pipeline capacity.

Australia Stocks Rise Further — Australian equities advanced 43 points, or 0.5%, to 8,739 in early Thursday trade, extending prior gains as a rebound in U.S. stock futures lifted sentiment after an overnight retreat on Wall Street following the Federal Reserve’s first rate hike in three years. Bargain hunting persisted following a near ten-week local low earlier this week, with investors weighing sticky inflation and the likelihood of another Reserve Bank move later this month. Meanwhile, Reserve Bank Governor Michele Bullock is scheduled to testify before Parliament on Friday. 【Hainan's first Hualong One unit to enter commercial operation】Today (17th) Huaneng Changjiang Nuclear Phase II Unit 3, the Hainan Free Trade Port’s first Hualong One reactor, is set to begin commercial operation. The unit uses China’s domestically developed third‑generation Hualong One technology and the nation’s first fully domestically controlled, group‑level nuclear production management system. It will supply over 9 bln kWh of clean power to the Hainan grid annually. Malaysia 10-Year Yield Hits Nearly 2-Year High — Malaysia’s 10-year government bond yield rose to 4.22%, its highest level since December 2024, tracking a surge in global bond yields following the Federal Reserve’s first rate hike in three years. This added to pressure on Malaysian bonds amid increased bond supply and growing expectations of monetary tightening by Bank Negara Malaysia. The central bank maintained its rate pause earlier this month while signaling potential rate hikes ahead, after the economy grew 6% year-on-year in the second quarter, driven by continued domestic demand and robust exports. Swaps now imply an 80% chance of a 50-bps rate hike over the next 12 months, up from pricing of less than 25 bps at the end of August. Meanwhile, higher Japanese rates have increased the risk of yen-funded carry-trade unwinding, potentially prompting foreign investors to reduce exposure to Malaysian bonds and further pushing yields higher.

【SAMR issues risk-control checklist for online food sales】The State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) has issued a Food Safety Risk Control Checklist for online food sales, targeting three operator types: live-stream e-commerce platform operators, third-party online food trading platform providers, and online food-selling enterprises. For each entity the checklist specifies control steps, risk points, control measures, control targets and control frequency, providing an operational guide for precise prevention of food-safety risks. The document is a key supporting instrument implementing the Provisions on Supervision and Administration of Live-stream E-commerce Operators' Implementation of the Main Responsibility for Food Safety and the Provisions on Supervision and Administration of Online Food Sales Operators' Implementation of the Main Responsibility for Food Safety, and signals a shift in online food-safety regulation from baseline defence to targeted, risk-oriented prevention. The checklist breaks the online food-sales chain into minimal work units and aims to move firms from passive compliance toward proactive risk control.

【中信期貨：點陣圖確認加息週期開啟，壓制黃金趨勢】日內黃金震盪下跌，主要緣於美聯儲連續加息計價預期壓制。宏觀方面，17日美聯儲公佈9月議息結果，FOMC以12-0投票決定將聯邦基金目標區間上調25個基點至3.75%-4.00%，為自2023年7月以來首次加息；會議釋放的最大增量資訊並非單次加息本身，而是點陣圖與釋出會共同確認加息週期開啟。具體來看，提交點陣圖的18位官員中，有4位官員認為2026年應累計加息75個基點（6月為1位），有12位官員認為應累計加息50個基點（6月為5位），有2位官員認為應累計加息25個基點（6月為3位）。此外，最新公佈的美國8月零售資料反彈幅度亦明顯超預期，印證美國經濟韌性，強化加息計價。美國8月零售銷售月率1.2%，高於預期0.8%和前值-0.5%；美國8月核心零售銷售月率1.4%，高於預期0.5%和前值-0.2%。地緣方面，日內油價高位小幅回落，WTI原油跌幅近2%，前期由能源價格快速上漲形成的通脹壓力邊際緩和。但沙特東西輸油管道受損後，Yanbu港裝運仍處暫停狀態，霍爾木茲海峽通航仍受阻，中東能源供應風險尚未明顯緩解。

【韓國：美聯儲加息對本土市場影響有限】韓國財政部發布宣告稱，韓國金融監管部門認為美聯儲加息對韓國本土市場影響有限，市場已基本消化該預期，整體金融環境保持穩定。美聯儲政策決議出爐後，韓國舉行會議，參會人員包括經濟財政部長具潤哲、韓國央行行長申鉉松以及各金融監管機構負責人，上述表態出自本次會議。韓國有關部門表示，國債市場波動有所加大，若市場出現過度異動，將採取必要的市場穩定措施。當局將密切監控油價與全球資本流動，並協同評估其對國內金融及外匯市場造成的影響。

New Zealand Dollar Holds Decline on Hawkish Fed — The New Zealand dollar traded around $0.571, an over two-month low, amid a hawkish US Federal Reserve, while investors assessed GDP data at home. The Fed raised interest rates for the first time in three years, bringing the target range to 3.75%-4.00%, and signaled that another hike was likely before year-end, boosting the US dollar. Limiting further losses in the kiwi, however, data showed New Zealand’s economy expanded 0.2% in the three months to June, slightly exceeding the 0.1% market forecast and the Reserve Bank's expectation for no growth. Annual GDP increased 2.6%, also beating the expected 2.2%. The figures pointed to some resilience in economic activity despite the severe energy shock stemming from the Middle East conflict. Earlier this month, the RBNZ raised rates for a second consecutive time but indicated a less aggressive tightening path. However, markets expect the cash rate to reach 3.0% by December, as the recent oil price spike has raised upside inflation risks.

Japanese Shares Rise After Fed Decision — The Nikkei 225 Index climbed 0.5% to above 64,200, while the broader Topix Index advanced 1% to 4,100 on Thursday, extending gains from the previous session even after the US Federal Reserve raised interest rates and signaled further tightening to contain inflation. The yen weakened against the dollar following the Fed’s decision, improving the earnings outlook for Japan’s export-focused industries. Japanese equities also benefited from declining oil prices amid expectations that crude flows through Saudi Arabia’s East-West pipeline could resume soon, easing pressure on the country’s oil-dependent economy. Gains were broad-based, with notable performances from index heavyweights such as SoftBank Group (1.2%), Mitsubishi UFJ (0.6%), Fujikura (2.7%), Mitsubishi Heavy Industries (3.1%) and Nintendo (3.3%).

Macau Hikes Base Rate to 4.25% after Fed Move — The Macau Monetary Authority lifted the base rate by 25 bps to 4.25% on September 17, 2026, mirroring the decision of its Hong Kong counterpart after the US Federal Reserve delivered the expected 25 bps hike on September 16. It was the first interest rate hike since July 2023 in the Chinese special administrative region. The move comes amid easing GDP growth and slowing inflation. The latest data showed that Macau’s economy grew 0.3% year-on-year in Q2 2026, slowing sharply from a 7.1% expansion in Q1, while inflation eased for the second straight month to 1.12% in July 2026. Under the linked exchange rate system, Macau’s base rate is set at par with Hong Kong’s base rate, which is typically 50 basis points above the lower end of the target range for the US federal funds rate.

【12306客服回應新增瀘州東站購票彈窗提醒】近日，多家媒體報道旅客建議將距離瀘州市區約30公里的瀘州東站改名一事，引發熱議。9月16日，在12306購買前往瀘州東站的車票過程中，新增一項彈窗頁面，提示稱“您所選‘瀘州東站’位於瀘縣雲錦鎮。請您仔細核對出行目的地，合理規劃行程。”對此，12306客服表示，該功能為近期新增。客服表示，“瀘州東站剛建成不久，旅客對其位置尚不熟悉，此前也無相關提示，故對此進行最佳化。”據此前報道，瀘州站、瀘州東站儘管只有一字之差，但後者距離瀘州市區約30公里。自渝昆高鐵渝宜段2024年開通以來，已有不少誤認為瀘州東站位於市區而“買錯票”“下錯站”的旅客建議修改站名。（中新經緯）

【China International Capital Co: Gold support seen near $4,200–4,500】China International Capital Co (CICC) says the Fed is more likely to pause than hike, leaving markets positioned like long-call bets on uncertain upside. Using a static model of US Treasury yields and the dollar, CICC estimates gold support around $4,200–$4,500. Unless the Fed delivers consecutive hikes, downside pressure on gold is relatively contained; meaningful upside, however, requires a broader narrative. A Fed pause could feed narratives of lost confidence and de‑dollarization, while hikes would weaken that storyline, so upside is larger under no-hike scenarios and dependent on further narrative catalysts.

Australian Dollar Holds at 1-Month Low — The Australian dollar held below $0.71, sitting at a four-week low after the Federal Reserve’s first interest-rate increase since 2023 boosted the US dollar, overshadowing expectations for further RBA tightening. The Fed unanimously raised its federal funds rate by 25 basis points to 3.75%-4.00% as expected, citing elevated inflation, while updated projections showed 16 of 18 officials expect at least one more hike this year. Focus now turns to the Reserve Bank of Australia’s September 29 policy decision, with markets pricing an 85% chance of a 25bp increase from the current 4.35% rate and expectations for the cash rate to reach 4.85% by early 2027. The IMF also flagged persistent inflation and rising energy prices as risks that could require further RBA rate hikes. Meanwhile, traders continued to monitor developments in the Iran-US war and its impact on oil prices. Crude remains above $100 per barrel, although prices are easing as Saudi Arabia works to restore pipeline capacity.

Singapore NODX Growth Strongest Since 1988 — Singapore’s non-oil domestic exports (NODX) surged 46.2% year-on-year in August 2026, accelerating sharply from a downwardly revised 24.1% rise in July. It was the twelfth straight month of expansion and the strongest growth since October 1988, driven by electronics exports (131.8% vs. 112% in July), supported by robust AI-related demand. In May, the country raised its 2026 forecast for NODX growth to 3.0%–5.0%, up from the previously estimated. Monthly, NODX jumped 10.9%, rebounding sharply from a 0.3% fall in July and marking the fastest increase in four months.

【中金：不排除美聯儲進一步加息的可能性，但最終是否加息、何時加息，仍取決於經濟資料】中金公司研報認為，美聯儲9月加息25個基點，整體基調較市場預期更為鷹派。決策以12比0全票透過，點陣圖暗示年內或再加息一次。官員們上調增長、下調失業率預測，並認為通脹回落需更長時間。沃什在記者會上將通脹列為主要矛盾，釋放了明確的抗通脹訊號。往前看，不排除美聯儲進一步加息的可能性，但最終是否加息、何時加息，仍取決於經濟資料。市場反應上，兩年期收益率上行、30年期走平，曲線平坦化，美元上漲、黃金下跌。這表明市場對於美聯儲遏制通脹的信心有所增強，此前因政策不確定性而形成的風險溢價有望下降，有利市場穩定。

【伊藤忠商事：伯克希爾或增持日本綜合商社股份】日本綜合商社行業協會負責人表示，伯克希爾・哈撒韋公司正考慮增持日本綜合商社的股份。日本對外貿易會會長岡藤正廣（Masahiro Okafuji）稱，他本月早些時候與伯克希爾執行長格雷格・阿貝爾會面後認為，這家美國投資機構 “打算長期持有這些商社的股份，甚至正在考慮增持”。伯克希爾在三菱商事、住友商事、三井物產、丸紅以及伊藤忠商事（岡藤正廣同時擔任該公司會長）均持有超 10% 的股份。阿貝爾本月早些時候在日本會見了上述企業高管，並在接受採訪時表示，伯克希爾可能提高對這些公司的持股比例。

【土耳其資產合計75億美元的兩支基金贖回違約】土耳其的Tera Portfoy Yonetimi AS表示，旗下兩隻資產總額達3,660億里拉（75億美元）的基金未能滿足贖回請求，這使其成為本週第二家宣佈部分基金違約的土耳其資產管理公司。這家公司在提交給伊斯坦布林證券交易所的兩份單獨檔案中表示，兩支基金 —— Tera Portfoy貨幣市場基金 (TP2) 和Tera Portfoy股票密集型基金 (THF) —— 均出現贖回違約。Tera的基金近年來取得的收益在土耳其投資基金市場名列前茅，進而吸引了大量資金流入。此前一天，Pusula Portfoy Yonetimi AS表示，其部分投資和貨幣市場基金無法滿足贖回需求，導致土耳其股市大跌。伊斯坦布林證交所100指數週三一度下跌7.7%，觸發熔斷機制，隨後跌幅收窄，最終收跌5.5%。該基準指數創下自2025年3月以來最大兩日跌幅。

【China Galaxy Securities: compute-network buildout boosts fiber demand; tight supply fuels high-cycle outlook】China Galaxy Securities says compute-network construction and AI-driven demand are materially lifting optical-fiber demand. Both expansion at compute-network backbone layers and upgrades to intra-data-center optical interconnects are creating significant incremental volume. The market is in a structural shortage as demand growth far outpaces supply release; China Galaxy expects the supply gap may continue to widen. Leading suppliers with high preform self-sufficiency should see price gains convert into outsized margin expansion. The fiber sector is shifting from a traditional telecom cyclical to a higher-growth compute-infrastructure theme.

【香港金管局宣佈調整基本利率至4.25%】香港金融管理局今日（17日）宣佈，基本利率根據預設公式定於4.25釐，即時生效。   據瞭解，香港基本利率是用作計算經貼現窗進行回購交易時適用的貼現率的基礎利率。目前基本利率定於當前的美國聯邦基金利率目標區間的下限加50基點，或隔夜及一個月香港銀行同業拆息的五天移動平均數的平均值，以較高者為準。   因應美國於9月16日（美國時間）調高聯邦基金利率的目標區間25基點，當前的美國聯邦基金利率目標區間的下限加50基點是4.25%，而隔夜及一個月香港銀行同業拆息的五天移動平均數的平均值是2.50%，所以根據預設公式，基本利率設定於4.25%。（大灣區之聲）

【HKMA raises base rate 25bps to 4.25%】The Hong Kong Monetary Authority raised its base rate by 25bps to 4.25%, its first move since 2023, ending a period of rate stability. The hike directly mirrors a same-day Fed action and is intended to preserve the Hong Kong dollar’s linked exchange rate with the US dollar. The HKMA said it is synchronizing policy with the Fed to ensure peg stability. Markets remain uncertain about pass-through to local funding costs; major banks typically announce lending-rate adjustments later this evening, with the Prime Rate the key focus.

【華泰證券：美聯儲10月加息必要性下降 預計12月再次加息為基準情形】當前市場定價美聯儲10月加息機率超過50%，但華泰證券認為，財政脈衝下降、油價對居民消費侵蝕加大以及金融條件收緊，就業和通脹資料在未來1—2個月或有所降溫，美聯儲10月加息的必要性下降，預計12月再次加息為基準情形，而2027年美聯儲的加息路徑取決於後續經濟資料表現，特別是就業市場是否將持續改善，進而推動工資增速回升，以及通脹的走勢。

【Huatai Securities: Need for Fed October rate hike diminished; December hike baseline】Huatai Securities says after the Fed’s September hike, December is likely the next substantive policy window and whether the Fed reopens a rate-hike cycle will depend on further data and officials’ remarks. Markets currently price a >50% chance of an October move, but Huatai judges the need for an October hike reduced given a waning fiscal impulse, oil-driven weakness in household consumption, tighter financial conditions and the prospect that employment and inflation may cool over the next 1–2 months. Huatai’s base case is for another hike in December. The Fed’s 2027 path will hinge on incoming economic data—especially whether the labour market sustains improvement that drives wage growth and on subsequent inflation dynamics.

【中信證券：預計美聯儲年內將再加息25bps 明年可能按兵不動】中信證券研報認為，美聯儲9月如期加息25bps，上調今年增長及通脹預測，點陣圖和沃什發言均釋放鷹派訊號。市場強烈的預期壓力讓加息成為美聯儲順水推舟的選擇。美聯儲後續加息的節奏與幅度在很大程度上取決於油價，這難以預測，但鑑於總體通脹率同比或會在明年初明顯下行，屆時繼續加息的理由應會弱化。我們預計美聯儲年內將再加息25bps，明年可能按兵不動。

【比亞迪董秘李黔：未來會繼續在半導體領域投入和發力】9月16日，比亞迪在比亞迪紹興賽車場舉辦高管面對面股東交流會，比亞迪集團董事會秘書、投資處總經理李黔表示，半導體是比亞迪非常重要的能力之一，晶片種類覆蓋13大類，567款車規晶片產品，從最早的功率半導體到模擬晶片，再到今年向邏輯晶片的拓展。比亞迪半導體擁有晶片設計、晶圓製造、封裝測試全鏈路設計與製造的能力。未來比亞迪在半導體領域，無論是設計還是生產，都還會持續突破。隨著汽車智慧化的發展，整車半導體的價值量也會顯著提升，因此比亞迪未來還會繼續在半導體領域投入和發力。今年推出的璇璣A3晶片是中國首款車規級4nm智駕晶片，目前已開啟規模化量產。

【網路消費繁榮發展 支援政策仍有發力空間】9月15日，國家統計局釋出的資料顯示，今年1月份至8月份，全國網上商品和服務零售額134766億元，同比增長4.6%。受訪專家普遍表示，相關部門需要繼續謀劃出臺務實管用的增量政策，引導網路交易經營者依法合規經營，營造安全放心的網路消費環境，切實維護好廣大消費者的合法權益；補齊下沉市場商品流通短板，鼓勵並支援快遞企業夯實縣域硬體基礎設施，提升末端配送效率；提高線上服務供給質量，推動服務內容、收費專案、退訂條件以及服務人員資質等清晰展示，增強線上承諾與線下履約的一致性。（證券日報）

【鈉電池龍頭髮布新品 業績高增長超跌概念股出爐】在鈉電產業化從技術驗證走向規模化應用的關鍵節點，國產鈉電企業新品迎來新突破。據中國能源報訊息，9月16日，海辰儲能在“朝夕為證”線上新品釋出會上，正式釋出新一代儲能專用鈉電一體化解決方案，推出搭載∞Cell N785Ah大容量鈉離子電池的4MWh鈉電儲能系統——∞Power N4.0MWh，並宣佈將於2027年開啟全鏈條量產交付。據證券時報·資料寶統計，今年上半年淨利潤同比增長20%以上（含扭虧為盈）的鈉電池概念股有25只，其中22只股票最新收盤價較年內高點回撤30%以上。從機構關注情況來看，上述22只業績高增長且股價大幅回撤的鈉電池概念股中，截至9月16日收盤，共有6股獲得10家以上機構“積極型”評級（含買入、增持、強烈推薦等），分別是寧德時代、天賜材料、海博思創、先導智慧、當升科技、鵬輝能源。

【CITIC Securities sees one more 25bps Fed hike this year】CITIC Securities says the Fed raised 25bps in September as expected and upgraded its growth and inflation forecasts; the dot plot and Fed remarks were hawkish. Strong market expectations made the September hike the path of least resistance. The timing and size of further hikes will depend heavily on oil prices, which remain unpredictable; with headline inflation YoY likely to drop notably in early next year, the case for additional tightening should weaken. CITIC expects one more 25bps hike before year-end and a likely pause next year. US financial conditions are unlikely to ease meaningfully; investors should favour assets with fundamental support rather than those that rely solely on liquidity.

【國慶假期首日火車票，今日開售】今年的國慶假期是10月1日到7日，根據火車票預售期15天的規則，今天就可以購買國慶假期首日的火車票了。今年中秋假期與國慶假期時間接近，兩節臨近也帶動機票、酒店的預訂量上漲。平臺資料顯示，截至9月16日，“中秋”“國慶”等關鍵詞搜尋量環比上月增長167%，本週國慶機票酒店預訂量環比上週增長56%，熱門2000公里以上航線預訂量同比翻番。

【雲頂新耀：維適平由境外轉移至境內生產的藥品上市註冊申請獲國家藥監局受理】9月17日，雲頂新耀宣佈，中國國家藥品監督管理局（NMPA）藥品審評中心（CDE）已受理維適平®（精氨酸艾曲莫德片，VELSIPITY®）由境外轉移至境內生產的藥品上市註冊申請，並納入優先審評審批程式。維適平®本地化生產有望於2027年正式投產。維適平®於2026年2月獲NMPA批准上市，用於治療對傳統治療或生物製劑應答不充分、失應答或不耐受的中度至重度活動性潰瘍性結腸炎（UC）成人患者。

【原料成本大幅攀升 炭黑市場回暖】9月16日，炭黑概念股集體異動，龍星科技、黑貓股份漲停，永東股份、聯科科技等同步走高。近期，國內炭黑市場迎來一輪爆發式上漲，主流產品報價接連突破歷史關口。截至9月16日，生意社炭黑基準價報12778.57元/噸，較月初（9142.8元/噸）上漲39.77%。“受主焦煤、配煤等上游原煤供給收緊、煤價堅挺影響，焦化企業生產成本居高不下，持續陷入虧損狀態。為控制虧損幅度、最佳化生產效益，多數焦化企業主動壓減生產負荷、延長裝置檢修週期，行業整體開工率大幅下滑。”有業內人士記者表示。產能收縮直接導致煤焦油副產品產出量銳減，市場商品流通貨源大幅縮減，現貨庫存持續低位，煤焦油價格開啟快速跳漲模式、一路衝高。原料成本的大幅攀升，抬高了炭黑企業的整體生產成本，形成強有力的成本倒逼漲價邏輯，為炭黑漲價提供了核心支撐。（證券日報）

HKMA Lifts Base Rate to 4.25% Following Fed Hike — The Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) raised its base rate by 25bps to 4.25% on September 17, 2026, marking its first hike since 2023 and following the U.S. Fed’s decision to lift its federal funds target range for the first time in three years. The move reflects Hong Kong’s Linked Exchange Rate System, which keeps the Hong Kong dollar within a 7.75–7.85 per U.S. dollar trading band and requires local interest rates to broadly track U.S. monetary policy, regardless of domestic economic conditions. The HKMA’s move came as Hong Kong’s economy continues to benefit from robust trade, although higher borrowing costs could weigh on a property market only recently emerging from a prolonged downturn. Sentiment may also remain cautious amid concerns over China’s efforts to curb mainland capital outflows. Meanwhile, GDP grew 4.3% yoy in Q2 2026, slowing from 5.9% in Q1 as household consumption and fixed investment growth eased, while government spending remained subdued.

【谷歌在美國司法部提起的廣告技術壟斷訴訟中敗訴】根據美國司法部發布公告，司法部反壟斷局在針對谷歌網路廣告技術（Ad Tech）市場的壟斷訴訟（United States et al. v. Google LLC）中贏得了重大的實質性救濟裁決。 弗吉尼亞州東區聯邦地方法院在判決中重申，必須終結谷歌的壟斷、消除其反競爭行為帶來的市場束縛，並拒絕讓谷歌繼續享有其非法獲得的壟斷勢力和利潤。法院明確駁回了谷歌關於“終結壟斷不屬於壟斷案適當目標”的抗辯。

【Axios: Trump to meet Gulf leaders next week on Iran】Axios, citing three people, says Trump is expected to meet Gulf leaders or foreign ministers next Tuesday in New York during the UN General Assembly — Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Qatar, Bahrain, Kuwait and Oman — to discuss next steps in the war with Iran. The meeting will focus on a U.S. post-war strategy; Trump and senior advisers are drafting a plan they expect to finalize after the midterm elections. One source said the meeting could be expanded to include other Arab and Muslim leaders. An Israeli source said Prime Minister Netanyahu also wants a meeting in New York with Trump but none is scheduled. Trump said on Wednesday he hopes "we are close to the end of the war" and repeated that he has heard directly from Iran that it wants to reach an agreement.
【印度計劃向“掃碼支付”收費】全球交易量最大的零售快速支付系統迎來重大變革。據印度新德里電視臺15日報道，印度擬對透過統一支付介面（UPI）向商戶支付、金額超過2000印度盧比（100印度盧比約合7元人民幣）的交易收取費用。結束多年來零成本支付的時代。作為印度數字公共基礎設施領域的關鍵專案之一，UPI自2016年上線以來實現明顯發展，年交易量超2400億筆。
【剛果（金）東南部交通事故致至少33人死亡】據剛果（金）媒體16日報道，位於該國東南部的上加丹加省米圖瓦巴地區發生一起交通事故，造成至少33人死亡、約20人受傷。 報道援引上加丹加省交通部門的訊息說，15日夜間至16日凌晨時段，一輛從鄰近的上洛馬米省駛來的卡車在米圖瓦巴地區墜入河中，事故死傷人數可能會上升。 報道說，事故原因仍在進一步調查中。

【AI“劫持”網站並偷建“地下論壇”，國安部披露細節】國家安全部今天釋出安全提示文章。近期，一起此前未獲披露的事件引發廣泛關注。今年5月至6月，一批與美國開放人工智慧研究中心（OpenAI）相關的AI智慧體在執行測試任務期間，“劫持”了德國程式設計師維基網站（DseWiki），將原本用於技術交流的開放社群改造為供智慧體相互傳遞資訊、分享測試任務答案和突破執行環境限制方法的“地下論壇”，累計釋出一萬多條資訊……當AI智慧體被賦予越來越多的現實行動能力，技術迭代與安全圍欄之間的縫隙，正在悄然擴大。國家安全部提醒，人工智慧安全風險正在快速演進，必須引起重視、加強防範。
【A股分紅派息轉增一覽：30股今日股權登記】Wind資料顯示，根據上市公司權益分配方案梳理統計，30只A股今日股權登記。其中，30股擬派息。分紅派息方面，30只個股分紅派息的股權登記日為9月17日。恆逸石化、睿創微納、成都銀行分紅力度最大，每10股分別派息9.00元、5.00元、4.89元。此外，還有2股丟擲分紅派息預案，中國鋁業、特發服務擬分紅力度最大，每10股擬分別派息2.76元、1.6元。

【A股定增一覽：6家公司披露定增進展】Wind資料顯示，9月17日，A股共6家公司釋出定增相關公告。其中4家定增預案獲股東大會透過，2家定增預案獲證監會透過。今年以來，已有137家公司公告定增方案已完成，48家公司定增金額超10億元。具體來看，中國國航、中國神華、松發股份定增募資金額最高，募資總額分別為200.0億元、200.0億元、70.0億元。
【特朗普下週將與海灣國家領導人就伊朗問題舉行會談】三位知情人士透露，特朗普總統預計下週二在紐約聯合國大會期間，與海灣國家領導人舉行會晤，商討對伊朗戰事的後續安排。此次會議預計將重點討論美國提出的戰後戰略構想。特朗普及其高層團隊正在制定戰後方案，該方案預計將在中期選舉後敲定。一名以色列訊息人士稱，以色列總理本雅明・內塔尼亞胡也希望在紐約與特朗普會面，但目前尚未安排相關會談。

US Futures Rise After Fed-Driven Selloff — US stock futures moved higher on Thursday after the major averages declined in the previous session as the Federal Reserve delivered its first interest rate hike in three years. Dow futures gained 0.2%, while S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 futures advanced 0.3% and 0.5%, respectively. In regular trading on Wednesday, the Dow dropped 1.21%, weighed down by losses among financial services stocks. The S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite also fell 0.45% and 0.01%, respectively, giving up gains made earlier in the session. As widely expected, the Fed raised its benchmark interest rate by 25 basis points to 3.75%-4% while signaling another rate increase later this year. The central bank is seeking to curb inflationary pressures as oil prices climbed above $100 per barrel. In corporate news, Generac jumped 33% in extended trading after Amazon received warrants to purchase up to $340 million worth of its shares under an agreement for Generac to supply backup power generators to Amazon’s data centers.
WTI crude plunged, hitting a low of $96.67/bbl.
Axios reports US President Trump will meet Gulf leaders next week to discuss Iran.

【專家料秋糧或維持豐收格局 糧價大幅上漲缺乏支撐】超強厄爾尼諾擾動全球農業生產，疊加中東地緣衝突持續發酵，全球糧食供給不確定性顯著上升。 業內人士分析，今年國內秋糧大機率維持豐收格局，總產量存在增長空間，糧價大幅上漲缺乏支撐。後續走勢需持續關注厄爾尼諾演化及地緣、需求端變數。 “我國堅持‘口糧絕對安全，穀物基本自給’的糧食戰略，今年國內秋糧大局已定，超強厄爾尼諾對秋糧的實質性衝擊有限，並未造成大範圍災害。”上海鋼聯糧食行業分析師劉棟告訴記者，“以玉米市場為例，當前國核心心矛盾仍是供強需弱。新季糧食豐產，疊加生豬去產能壓制飼用消費，替代穀物供給充足，新季玉米供需整體寬鬆，短期不具備價格大幅上漲基礎。不過國內外種植成本抬升，玉米價格暴跌空間同樣有限，中長期價格底部存在震盪抬升的可能性。”（證券時報）

【中信建投：8月經濟資料不改債市趨勢】中信建投研報認為，8月經濟資料公佈，延續先前內需較弱、供強於需的總體格局，不改債市緩慢偏強的長期趨勢。1-8月，社會消費品零售總額同比增長1.1%、固定資產投資完成額同比下降7.2%，消費及投資增速仍處於歷史較低水平，內需承壓特徵明顯。外需方面，8月貿易差額0.81萬億元，同比增長11.9%，增速再創3月以來新高，外部需求動能繼續邊際改善。總體上，當前資料體現的基本面結構未出現明顯變化，中短期內對債市無增量影響，長期則繼續支援債市緩慢偏強。後續可繼續關注是否有增量政策落地，並關注包括三季度GDP在內的總量經濟資料的邊際變化情況。

【KEVIN WARSH holds 30-minute press conference, shortest since 2011】Federal Reserve Chair KEVIN WARSH held a roughly 30-minute post-meeting press conference Wednesday, the shortest since routine chair briefings began in 2011. He stuck to a pledge not to pre-announce Fed moves, confining comments to this week's meeting and officials' current economic views. The Fed reordered press-room seating alphabetically by outlet, moving AFP to the front and shifting Wall Street Journal and Refinitiv reporters rearward. A special working group Warsh created is reviewing the Fed's communications, including press conferences, leaving open the possibility the briefing format could be changed or discontinued.

【中信建投：全球半導體裝置零部件正經歷一輪歷史罕見的全鏈條漲價潮】中信建投研報認為，全球半導體裝置零部件正經歷一輪歷史罕見的全鏈條漲價潮。半導體產業鏈的定價權正從晶片終端向裝置與零部件環節結構性上移。零部件企業規模較小、固定成本佔比高，漲價直接轉化為利潤；同時產線擴產週期長達12-18個月，供給彈性最差。重視閥門管路、陶瓷件、射頻電源、GAS BOX等海外供應商交期延長帶來的國產替代訴求與漲價邏輯。
【美聯儲10月加息機率為49.8%】9月17日，據CME“美聯儲觀察”：美聯儲到10月維持利率不變的機率為50.2%，累計加息25個基點的機率為49.8%。美聯儲到12月維持利率不變的機率為11.3%，累計加息25個基點的機率為50.1%，累計加息50個基點的機率為38.6%。
【烏克蘭防空部門：烏克蘭首都基輔遭導彈襲擊】烏克蘭防空部門發出警告，基輔正遭受導彈襲擊，首都區域可聽見爆炸聲。

【上游原料價格持續上漲，染料企業跟進漲價】近期，染料行業漲價受到關注。9月初，浙江龍盛、閏土股份等染料龍頭集中提價。在上游，國內H酸市場均價站上15萬元/噸，較年初上漲275%，持續重新整理歷史高位。申萬宏源報告指出，傳統紡服旺季備庫週期將至，在上游中間體高景氣支撐下，染料價格有望持續上揚。此輪染料漲價並非簡單的季節性波動，而是上游中間體H酸供給端長期約束的集中爆發。H酸是酸性染料、直接染料及活性染料的生產中間體。資料顯示，2026年初，H酸價格約4萬元/噸，到9月初，部分廠家報價觸及15萬元/噸，價格重新整理歷史高位。染料的另一大原材料還原物的供給形勢同樣嚴峻。據生意社資料，還原物市場均價由2025年末的2.5萬元/噸漲至目前的10萬元/噸至12萬元/噸，年內漲幅接近380%。

【恒大汽車：已完成退出汽車製造，電池貿易業務上半年收入873萬元】9月17日早間，恒大汽車在2026年中期業績公告中披露，集團已採取若干計劃及措施以紓緩流動資金壓力及改善其財務狀況，包括但不限於以下者：(i)集團已完成退出汽車製造，並基於其保留的電動汽車電池及汽車製造相關專有技術，實施向輕資產業務模式的戰略轉型。集團繼續採取積極計劃及措施，透過不同渠道控制營運及行政成本，包括但不限於進行組織及人力資源的最佳化及調整以及控制經營開支。同時，集團一直利用其保留的技術優勢發展新業務活動，重建其收入基礎，主要包括鋰離子電池貿易業務，於報告期內，開始銷售併產生收入人民幣873萬元；及(ii)公司仍在與一名獨立投資者進行磋商，該投資者表示願意向集團提供融資，維持其基本運營及最低營運資金需求，包括支付專業及中介費用以及維持公司上市地位的開支。

【A股板塊輪動提速 公募新品加緊佈局傳統賽道】近期，市場熱點切換節奏加快，板塊輪動特徵愈發突出。在此背景下，公募行業開始將目光投向前期關注度較低的行業，密集申報發行冷門賽道基金，適配風格切換背景下避險資金的配置需求。證券時報記者注意到，不少公募正在加緊佈局傳統賽道的ETF以及主動權益產品。從發行名單來看，產品覆蓋多條細分賽道。例如，軟體板塊方面，南方基金、華寶基金、富國基金、永贏基金等將於近期推出軟體ETF及其聯接產品。農業賽道也迎來多家頭部基金公司卡位佈局，易方達基金、南方基金、華夏基金9月發售了糧食產業ETF聯接基金，華安也計劃推出中證農業主題指數基金。除此之外，鵬華基金、平安基金、東財基金等基金密集上報公用事業、數字經濟、家電、食品消費、工程機械等方向的指數產品。此外，過去一年在AI熱潮中遭到市場冷落、被公募低配的傳統網際網路板塊，同樣迎來新產品佈局。在經歷一輪市場調整後，匯添富基金、國聯基金、天弘基金等將在9月至10月陸續發行網際網路ETF及聯接基金，低位佈局意圖明顯。

Malaysia 10Y Bond Yield Hits 21-month High — Malaysia 10 Year Government Bond Yield increased to 4.24%, the highest since December 2024. Over the past 4 weeks, Malaysia 10Y Bond Yield gained 43.32 basis points, and in the last 12 months, it increased 77.30 basis points.
【高盛CEO警告固定收益業務表現將較弱，公司整體支出料增加】據報道，高盛執行長蘇德巍警告稱，該行固定收益交易業務表現弱於過去幾個季度，全公司的支出也在上升。蘇德巍週三在巴克萊的一場會議上表示，第三財季固定收益交易業務表現弱於股票交易業務，後者仍然“非常強勁”。他表示，鑑於本季度與客戶的活動十分繁忙，加之加快了部分技術投資，預計高盛的成本支出將會增加。

【法國巴黎銀行建議做空 30 年期美國國債，目標收益率 5.6%】法國巴黎銀行美國利率策略主管古尼特・丁格拉（Guneet Dhingra,）表示，美聯儲週三加息並釋放偏鷹派指引，但此舉 “不足以穩住長端收益率”。他預測 30 年期美債收益率將觸及 2002 年以來最高水平。丁格拉與該行首席美國經濟學家詹姆斯・埃格爾霍夫在一份研報中寫道：“我們認為美聯儲此次行動有力回應了市場對其政策可信度的擔憂，目前可以不再將‘美聯儲政策可信度’視作看多長端收益率上行的理由。”該行建議客戶直接做空 30 年期美國國債（入場點位：5.36%，目標位 5.60%，止損位 5.20%）。
The U.S. Department of Justice said it has again secured significant relief in its lawsuit against Google (GOOG.O).

【碳酸鋰期價大幅回撥 產業鏈承壓短期供需料維持緊平衡】進入9月，本該迎來傳統“金九銀十”旺季的碳酸鋰市場卻走出一輪單邊下行走勢，帶動鋰礦板塊上市公司股價同步走弱。9月16日，國內碳酸鋰期貨主力合約價格盤中一度跌至124020元/噸，9月以來累計下跌逾兩成。回溯至今年5月份，國內碳酸鋰期貨主力合約價格最高一度在21萬元/噸左右，短短4個月跌去超四成，基本抹平年內漲幅。證券時報記者在採訪中瞭解到，本輪碳酸鋰價格下跌受到頭部電池廠下修排產傳聞、庫存統計口徑切換等市場訊息影響，或是對前期過度樂觀預期的調整。當然，也有觀點認為，美聯儲加息預期、市場對遠期需求的預期偏悲觀也是影響因素。業內人士認為，當前市場需求處於高位，碳酸鋰短期仍將維持供需緊平衡狀態，後續價格走勢需密切觀察終端需求、庫存變化及新增產能釋放情況。
日經指數期貨在新加坡交易所開盤上漲505點，報64350點。

【中信建投：全球半導體裝置零部件正經歷一輪歷史罕見的全鏈條漲價潮】中信建投研報認為，全球半導體裝置零部件正經歷一輪歷史罕見的全鏈條漲價潮。半導體產業鏈的定價權正從晶片終端向裝置與零部件環節結構性上移。零部件企業規模較小、固定成本佔比高，漲價直接轉化為利潤；同時產線擴產週期長達12-18個月，供給彈性最差。重視閥門管路、陶瓷件、射頻電源、GAS BOX等海外供應商交期延長帶來的國產替代訴求與漲價邏輯。
巴西國家石油公司（Petrobras）公告稱，自9月17日起，將對經銷商上調柴油均價，每升上調1雷亞爾。
烏克蘭首都基輔遭導彈襲擊。
法國巴黎銀行建議做空30年期美國國債，目標價位5.6%。
美國總統特朗普在北卡羅來納州發表講話。
標普500指數期貨上漲0.3%，納斯達克100指數期貨反彈。

【美聯儲主席沃什踐行自己的主張 召開了一場創紀錄短的記者會】美聯儲主席凱文·沃什曾表示，政策制定者應該少說話。週三他在例行政策會議後舉行了有記錄以來美聯儲主席最簡短的記者會，以此踐行了自己的建議。沃什在宣佈三年多來首次加息後舉行的例行記者會僅持續了約30分鐘。這是自2011年美聯儲主席開始定期舉行新聞釋出會以來最短的一次。這位主席堅持不預測美聯儲未來的行動，而是專注於本週的會議以及美聯儲官員目前對經濟的看法。美聯儲還調整了簡報室的座位安排。以往各大報紙和通訊社的記者都坐在前排，現在座位改為按媒體名稱字母順序排列。這意味著法新社的記者被安排在了前排，而《華爾街日報》和路透的記者則被安排在了房間後排。另外記者會的未來仍懸而未決。沃什設立的五個特別工作組之一將負責審查溝通機制。該工作組的任務是評估美聯儲如何在“不確定性中傳達政策審議和決定”，這一行動可能包括導致記者會以及其他溝通工具可能被取消。

Brent Extends Decline as Supply Concerns Ease — Brent crude fell to around $105.5 per barrel on Thursday, extending losses for a second consecutive session following reports that Saudi Arabia plans to restore roughly half the capacity of its East-West pipeline within days and bring it back to full operation within six weeks. The key pipeline, which provides an alternative route around the Strait of Hormuz, was damaged in drone attacks last week. In the meantime, Saudi Arabia has stepped up efforts to transport more crude through Hormuz with assistance from the US military. Meanwhile, US Energy Secretary Chris Wright said that 18 million barrels of crude and petroleum products passed through Hormuz earlier this week. In the US, official data showed that crude inventories declined by 640,000 barrels to 423.4 million barrels, although the decrease was smaller than analysts had anticipated. The figures differed sharply from the API’s earlier estimate of a 7.1 million-barrel increase in crude inventories.
【巴西央行降息25個基點至13.75%】當地時間9月16日，巴西央行將基準利率降至13.75%，符合預期。自3月啟動降息以來，累計降幅已達125個基點，這也是巴西央行連續第五次降息。巴西央行在宣告中表示，當前環境存在高度不確定性，通脹預期脫錨，同時基準情景面臨較高風險，因此貨幣政策操作需要保持冷靜和謹慎。委員會將繼續關注形勢發展，使貨幣政策保持足夠的限制性，以確保通脹向目標水平迴歸。

【美國眾議院將員工持股估值法案送交特朗普簽署】一項旨在明確員工持股計劃估值標準的兩黨法案已在美國眾議院獲得透過，現已送交美國總統特朗普簽署生效。眾議院週三以 401 票贊成、14 票反對的表決結果透過《透過持股實現退休法案》（S.2403）（Retire Through Ownership Act）。該投票結果凸顯國會對員工持股計劃（ESOP）的支援，在華盛頓黨派對立的大環境下，推動員工持股成為罕見的兩黨共識領域。法案將解決 “充分對價” 問題，這也是近期多起員工持股計劃相關訴訟的核心爭議點。法案一經簽署生效，將允許員工持股計劃受託人聘請獨立評估師，依據美國國稅局《收入裁定 59-60》開展估值。該裁定是美國國稅局出於稅務核算、股權轉讓及法律糾紛處理目的，用於確定非上市私營企業股份公允市場價值的指導檔案。

Oil Extends Decline as Supply Concerns Ease — Crude oil fell to around $102 per barrel on Thursday, extending losses for a second consecutive session following reports that Saudi Arabia plans to restore roughly half the capacity of its East-West pipeline within days and bring it back to full operation within six weeks. The key pipeline, which provides an alternative route around the Strait of Hormuz, was damaged in drone attacks last week. In the meantime, Saudi Arabia has stepped up efforts to transport more crude through Hormuz with assistance from the US military. Meanwhile, US Energy Secretary Chris Wright said that 18 million barrels of crude and petroleum products passed through Hormuz earlier this week. The figures differed sharply from the API’s earlier estimate of a 7.1 million-barrel increase in crude inventories.

【多個環節門檻提高 一級市場專項基金迴歸產業投資本源】今年以來，在一級市場，專項基金顯著升溫。由於資金投向確定性強的單一專案、基金規模較小、投資效率較高，專項基金成為不少創業投資和私募股權投資（VC/PE）機構“卡位”優質專案的有力“武器”。證監會近日釋出的《私募投資基金募集監督管理辦法（徵求意見稿）》從投資經驗、資產規模、出資門檻等方面提高了自然人有限合夥人（LP）投資專項基金的門檻。業內人士分析，監管的目標是“扶優限劣”，讓真正懂產業、做投資的機構留下，讓單純靠套利、賺通道差價的機構出局，這是行業共識，也是行業健康發展的關鍵。

【土耳其稱伊朗支援土方解散庫爾德工人黨】土耳其內政部16日發表宣告稱，伊朗支援土耳其解散庫爾德工人黨及其分支的相關行動。宣告稱，土耳其內政部長奇夫特奇和伊朗內政部長莫梅尼當天在土首都安卡拉舉行會談。奇夫特奇稱，解散庫爾德工人黨及其在敘利亞和伊拉克的分支，對於地區和平至關重要；同時，將伊朗境內活動的庫爾德斯坦自由生活黨納入這一程序同樣重要。莫梅尼呼籲土耳其、伊拉克、伊朗和敘利亞合作，推動庫爾德工人黨及其分支放下武器，實現庫爾德問題的根本解決。宣告說，雙方還就加強邊境安全合作、共同打擊有組織犯罪、毒品走私和非法移民等議題開展討論。

A major Democratic super PAC will commit another $10m to the Michigan Senate race to back progressive Democrat Abdul El-Sayed, Axios reports. Republicans view Michigan as a likely pickup and are running heavy ad campaigns in support of Mike Rogers.

【Evergrande Auto (00708.HK) files multiple financial reports on HKEX; total liabilities ~RMB32.722bn as of end-June】On Sept. 17 morning Evergrande Auto (00708.HK) filed multiple financial statements on HKEX. For the six months ended June 30, 2026 the group reported total assets of about RMB182m and total liabilities of about RMB32.722bn, including borrowings of RMB16.283bn and trade and other payables of RMB16.439bn. Revenue was about RMB9m, gross profit about RMB0.5m; net profit was about RMB186m, up approximately RMB771m YoY.

【Generac同亞馬遜達成資料中心發電機組供應協議】美國電力裝置製造商Generac當地時間9月16日向美國證監會提交檔案，宣佈同亞馬遜簽訂協議，向後者全資子公司Amazon.com NV Investment Holdings發行一份認股權證，賦予其以每股200.93美元的行權價格認購最多1,693,745股公司普通股的權利。Generac與亞馬遜簽署長期供應協議，預計2027年和2028年備用發電機的初始交付總額將達到24億美元。

【海上發射首戰告捷，千帆星座邁入工業化組網階段】9月，千帆星座發射頻次明顯提高。9月15日和9月16日，垣信衛星分別有10顆衛星和8顆衛星成功發射，千帆星座規模增至256顆。根據相關規劃，預計2026年底，千帆星座將完成324顆衛星發射，初步具備在全球關鍵區域提供商用衛星網際網路服務的能力。這意味著，未來近3個半月還將發射68顆衛星，千帆星座將邁入工業化組網階段。（上證報）

【美聯儲時隔3年多再加息，美國多家銀行上調最優惠利率至7%】當地時間9月16日，美聯儲宣佈將聯邦基金利率目標區間上調25個基點，使基準基金利率從3.50%至3.75%上調到3.75%至4%。美國各大銀行宣佈跟進上調優惠貸款利率（Prime Rate），摩根大通、紐約梅隆銀行等宣佈，優惠貸款利率從6.75%上調至7%，當地時間17日正式生效。優惠利率通常跟隨聯邦基金利率變動，銀行以此為基準為信用卡、個人貸款等眾多金融產品設定利率。

【香港跟隨美聯儲加息，為三年多來首次】香港金融管理局跟隨美國聯邦儲備委員會加息，這是 2023 年以來首次加息。香港金管局週四釋出宣告，將基準利率上調 25 個基點至 4.25%。香港金管局同步跟進美聯儲政策，以維護港元與美元的聯絡匯率制度。市場當前關注香港各大銀行（包括滙豐控股與渣打集團）將於當日晚些時候公佈的調整方案，其中包括最優惠貸款利率的變動。在香港，最優惠貸款利率是銀行按揭貸款的定價基準，因此即便基準利率收緊，銀行仍可透過調整該利率影響信貸與借貸需求。
【美國允許運輸汽油和柴油的卡車延長工作時間】美國交通部暫時放寬了駕駛時間規定。 允許運輸汽油和柴油的卡車司機在24小時內最多連續工作16小時，但必須按規定休息。 此舉旨在防止燃油短缺。

NZX 50 Edges Higher After GDP Data — The NZX 50 rose 8 points, or 0.1%, to 13,631 in Thursday morning trade, extending gains from the previous session following the release of New Zealand’s GDP data. Fresh data showed that New Zealand’s economy grew more than expected, with GDP rising 2.6% year-on-year, while easing to 0.2% quarter-on-quarter, amid elevated oil prices due to the ongoing Middle East conflict. However, the Fed’s decision to hike interest rates by 25 bps limited the gains. Traders continued to monitor developments in the Iran-US war and its impact on oil prices. Financials, healthcare, and utilities mainly drove the index, with top movers including Channel Infrastructure (1.5%), Freightways Group (0.7%), AFT Pharmaceuticals (0.5%), EBOS Group (0.5%), and Gentrack Group (0.5%).

【國金證券：光伏玻璃供給加速出清 龍頭盈利修復與份額回升確定性較高】國金證券釋出研報稱，光伏企業中報進一步驗證產業鏈價格、盈利底部夯實，行業持續虧損背景下尾部產能及企業陸續出清，疊加強制國標、成本核算通則等實施，光伏板塊左側夯實。當前二三線企業仍處現金虧損，後續供給仍有下降空間，約3.3萬噸產能可視作實質性出清。頭部企業盈利修復確定性較高，同時有望憑藉盈利及資金優勢維持快於行業的產能增速，實現份額回升。

【恒大汽車(00708)釋出2025年度業績 股東應占虧損8.91億元 同比盈轉虧】恒大汽車(00708)釋出截至2025年12月31日止年度全年業績，該集團期內取得收入1301.1萬元(人民幣，下同)，同比減少75.59%;股東應占虧損8.91億元，同比盈轉虧;每股基本虧損8.218分。公告稱，收入減少主要由於提供技術服務的收入從2024年的2537萬元下降至報告期的1287萬元，以及本集團終止物業開發活動後，報告期內並無物業銷售(2024年：2228萬元)。服務歐洲客戶的技術服務業務為本集團於報告期內的主要及經常性收入來源。報告期內，本集團的收入主要來自透過National Electric Vehicle Sweden AB(NEVS，本公司於瑞典註冊成立的間接全資附屬公司)向歐洲客戶提供技術服務(技術服務業務)。本集團亦繼續籌備開展鋰離子電池貿易業務(電池貿易業務)。於本公告日期，本集團不再經營任何汽車製造業務，本集團於中國的所有生產設施已透過相關中國附屬公司的出售或破產程式予以出售或正在出售，而本集團的主要經營活動以輕資產經營模式透過其香港總部及NEVS進行。

【U.S. House passes first bill addressing economic impact of data center expansion】The U.S. House on Wednesday passed the Ratepayer Protection Act to shield households from electricity bill increases linked to data center expansion. The vote highlights a political split: President Trump backs data center growth as central to AI leadership, while lawmakers across parties face voter pressure over rising bills from surging power demand.

New Zealand Q2 GDP Annual Growth Hits 3-Year High — New Zealand’s economy expanded by 2.6% year-on-year in the three months to June 2026, following an upwardly revised 1.7% increase in the previous quarter and exceeding expectations of 2.3% growth. It was the fourth consecutive quarter of annual growth and the fastest pace since Q2 2023, as all sectors expanded. Goods-producing industries expanded faster (4.4% vs 0.1% in Q1), boosted by manufacturing (5.4%), construction (3.7%), and electricity, gas, water, and waste services (3.6%). Service industries grew 2.1% (unchanged from Q1), due mainly to higher wholesale trade (7.4%), public administration and safety (4.0%), retail trade and accommodation (2.6%), and healthcare and social assistance (2.4%). Primary industries also continued to grow (0.3% vs 0.6%), driven by agriculture, forestry, and fishing (1.7%). On a quarterly basis, the economy advanced 0.2% in Q2, slowing from an upwardly revised 0.9% growth in Q1 but surpassing forecasts of 0.1%.

【兩隻熊貓債指數昨日釋出】據中債金融估值中心網站訊息，9月16日，為多角度反映人民幣債券市場的走勢，給投資者提供多元化的業績比較基準和投資標的，中債金融估值中心有限公司釋出中債-熊貓債綜合指數與中債-投資優選熊貓債指數。今年以來，熊貓債市場持續火熱。Wind資料顯示，截至9月16日，年內熊貓債發行規模達到2430.45億元，持續重新整理歷史紀錄，同比增長率也高達81.44%。（證券日報）
【特朗普不滿美聯儲加息：美國利率應在1%或以下 趕緊降息！】在美聯儲如期宣佈加息25個基點後，美國總統特朗普立即做出了強烈回應，並要求迅速、大幅降低利率。特朗普在其社交媒體平臺Truth Social上發帖寫道。“美國的利率應該在1%甚至更低，因為我們是世界上信用最好的國家——遙遙領先！我們國家正蓬勃發展，新投資層出不窮！”

【從數量擴張到質量篩選，併購重組市場新動向受關注】近期，包括焦作萬方、金橙子、普路通在內的多家上市公司對外發布終止重大資產重組相關公告，引發市場關注。以普路通為代表的部分公司釋出終止公告後，股價出現明顯回撥。從終止重大資產重組的原因看，外部市場環境發生變化、交易雙方關鍵核心條款未達成一致是近期重組終止的兩大主因，其中不乏披露籌劃重組意向後不久便宣佈終止交易的案例。受訪專家認為，併購重組終止不是“利空一刀切”，影響要分主體、分原因看。終止案例密集出現的背後，交易雙方對標的質量、估值作價與產業協同的審視明顯趨嚴，併購市場有望從數量擴張轉入更充分的價格博弈與質量篩選階段。（中證報）

New Zealand Q2 GDP Growth Beats Estimates — New Zealand’s economy grew 0.2% quarter-on-quarter in Q2 2026, slowing from an upwardly revised 0.9% expansion in Q1 but slightly above forecasts of 0.1%. GDP growth was mainly driven by goods-producing industries, which rose 1.3%, supported by wholesale trade (1.3%). Meanwhile, service industries grew 0.2%, led by higher output in public administration and safety (2.0%), information media and telecommunications (1.7%), and healthcare and social assistance (0.8%). In contrast, primary industries contracted 0.3%, weighed down by mining activities (-0.4%).

【胡塞武裝：沙特40次空襲葉門 兩批戰機遭攔截後撤退】葉門胡塞武裝16日說，過去24小時內，沙烏地阿拉伯戰機對葉門3個省份發動40次空襲。胡塞武裝軍事發言人葉海亞·薩雷亞當日在社交媒體平臺發表宣告說，F-15戰鬥機從沙特西南部城市海米斯穆謝特的空軍基地起飛，對葉門西南部塔伊茲省、東北部馬裡卜省和西北部哈傑省發動上述空襲。此外，薩雷亞當晚在電視臺發表宣告說，胡塞武裝“不久前擊落一架沙特的武裝偵察無人機”，當時這架無人機正在馬裡卜省上空執行“敵對行動”。薩雷亞還說，當地時間18時40分，兩批F-15戰鬥機進入葉門西部沿海的塔伊茲省穆哈上空，胡塞武裝使用數枚自行製造的地對空導彈實施攔截，迫使這些戰機撤退。沙特方面尚未就胡塞武裝的說法作出回應。（新華社）

【加總理訪歐 欲向美國傳遞訊號】歐盟委員會主席馮德萊恩16日在歐洲議會上發表2026年度“盟情諮文”時表示，願同到訪的加拿大總理馬克·卡尼就加拿大成為歐盟首個“聯席成員”一同努力。加拿大總理卡尼此次訪問歐洲，提出加拿大正尋求與歐盟建立一種 “獨特的聯盟關係”。專家分析指出，在美加貿易爭端持續的背景下，加拿大此舉既是主動調整戰略、推進對外關係多元化，也是向美國釋放訊號，以此增加未來美加貿易談判的主動權。（央視新聞）

【U.S. House passes Russia sanctions bill, grants president tariff authority on Russian oil and gas imports】The U.S. House passed a Russia sanctions-and-tariffs bill 262-159; the measure will be sent to President Trump for signature. The bill targets Russian officials, companies and financial institutions that support the war in Ukraine and authorizes the president to impose tariffs on major importers of Russian oil and gas. Tariff authority was a key Democratic objection; Democrats warned it could allow the president to designate any country as aiding evasion and impose tariffs of up to 100% without oversight or a sunset clause.

【私募五大策略業績分化，量化多頭領跑】8月A股市場震盪反彈，帶動私募產品淨值普遍修復。第三方機構私募排排網資料顯示，截至8月31日，在該平臺有業績記錄的12597只私募產品8月平均收益率達4.53%，今年以來的平均收益率提升至4.99%，超六成產品實現正收益。五大策略表現顯著分化：8月股票策略以5.44%的平均收益率領跑，多資產策略、組合基金策略、期貨及衍生品策略的平均收益率分別為3.84%、3.47%和3.14%，債券策略當月的平均收益率為0.44%。 更值得關注的是股票策略內部的結構性分化——量化多頭單月平均收益率達9.71%，年內收益率由負轉正至6.62%，而主觀多頭8月平均收益率僅3.82%。有私募人士表示，這種分化的本質是各策略貝塔來源不同，並非簡單的“誰強誰弱”。（中證報）

【今年第25號颱風“杜鵑”生成】今年第25號颱風“杜鵑”（熱帶風暴級；英文名稱：Dujuan；名字來源：中國；意義：杜鵑花）已於昨天（16日）晚上在西北太平洋洋麵生成，今天（17日）早晨5點鐘其中心位於塞班東北方向約530公里的洋麵上，就是北緯18.1度、東經149.7度，中心附近最大風力有8級（20米/秒），中心最低氣壓為995百帕，七級風圈半徑為150~480公里。預計，“杜鵑”將以每小時40公里左右的速度向偏北轉西偏北方向移動，強度逐漸增強，19日開始轉向北到東北方向移動，逐漸趨向日本以南洋麵。未來“杜鵑”對我國近海無影響。（央視新聞）

Brazil Central Bank Cuts Selic to 13.75% — Brazil’s central bank cut its benchmark interest rate by 25 bps to 13.75% at its September meeting, in line with market expectations. The bank noted that the external environment remains uncertain due to the lack of clarity surrounding armed conflicts in the Middle East and uncertainty over monetary policy in some advanced economies. Domestically, indicators released since the previous meeting point to a gradual moderation in economic activity, particularly in more cyclical sectors, although activity remains resilient and the labor market remains tight. Recent data show that headline inflation and the average of underlying measures have slowed, standing below the upper bound of the tolerance interval but still above the target. The Copom reiterated that the current scenario, marked by significantly higher uncertainty, deanchored inflation expectations, and elevated risks around the baseline scenario, calls for caution.

【US-Mexico fourth USMCA talks delayed to Sept 28-29 in Washington】Fourth formal USMCA negotiation round between the US and Mexico has been postponed one week to Sept. 28-29 in Washington, originally scheduled for the week of Sept. 21, the Wall Street Journal reports. Talks will also cover tariff adjustments for steel, aluminum and autos as part of a US effort to tighten supply-chain rules and accelerate nearshoring of critical industries.

Canada 10-Year Yield Nears 3.94% — Canada’s 10-year government bond yield settled near 3.94% in mid-September after falling as low as 3.87% on lower oil prices. The yield then rose following the Federal Reserve’s rate hike, as the Fed raised the target range for the federal funds rate by 25 bps to 3.75%-4%. Updated Fed projections showed that most policymakers expect another hike before the end of 2026. The Bank of Canada kept its key policy rate unchanged at 2.25% at its September meeting, as widely expected. However, it noted that inflation risks had increased, while new tariffs had made the growth outlook more uncertain. Governor Macklem said policymakers were prepared to raise rates if inflation remained elevated. Still, a halt in the oil rally following reports of a potential recovery of Saudi Arabia’s key East-West pipeline helped to slow global yields.

US TIC Inflows Reach $83.7 Billion in July — Net foreign acquisitions of long-term securities, short-term US securities and banking flows resulted in a net TIC inflow of $83.7 billion in July 2026. Net foreign private inflows totaled $73.5 billion, while net foreign official inflows reached $10.2 billion. Foreign residents increased their holdings of long-term US securities, with net purchases of $40.6 billion, including net sales of $3.7 billion by private foreign investors and net purchases of $44.4 billion by foreign official institutions. US residents increased their holdings of long-term foreign securities, with net purchases of $68.5 billion. After adjustments, overall net foreign sales of long-term securities were estimated at $27.9 billion. Foreign residents also increased their holdings of US Treasury bills by $38.8 billion, while holdings of all dollar-denominated short-term US securities and other custody liabilities rose by $65 billion.

Canadian Dollar Weakens After Fed Hike — The Canadian dollar weakened to near 1.40 per USD in mid-September, its lowest level in more than a month after the US Federal Reserve raised interest rates as expected. The Fed raised the target range for the federal funds rate by 25 bps to 3.75%-4%, reinforcing the US dollar’s advantage over the loonie. Updated Fed projections showed that most policymakers expect another hike before the end of 2026, widening the interest-rate differential between the US and Canada. The Bank of Canada kept its key policy rate unchanged at 2.25% at its September meeting, as widely expected. However, it noted that inflation risks had increased, while new tariffs had made the growth outlook more uncertain. The BoC left the future path of monetary policy open, saying it would adjust policy as needed. Governor Macklem said policymakers were prepared to raise rates if inflation remained elevated.

【Wash's 28-minute press conference; predecessors averaged 54 minutes】A 2021 Federal Reserve study covering the Bernanke, Yellen and Powell eras found FOMC press conferences averaged about 54 minutes total, with roughly 10 minutes of opening remarks, about 44 minutes of media Q&A and an average of ~22 questions including follow-ups. A separate Fed study noted press conferences that begin ~30 minutes after the FOMC statement typically run about one hour. Wash's first press conference after taking office in 2026 lasted about 42 minutes; his latest in September ran roughly 28 minutes.

Kuwait Central Bank Holds Key Rate at 3.50% — The Central Bank of Kuwait held its key discount rate at 3.50% in September 2026, stating that current data reflected “the soundness and strength of monetary and financial stability” in the country. Gulf oil and gas exporters generally follow the Fed’s lead on rate moves, as most regional currencies are pegged to the US dollar. The Kuwaiti dinar is the exception, as it is pegged to a basket of currencies that includes the dollar. Most central banks in the Gulf Cooperation Council raised key interest rates following the US Federal Reserve’s decision to hike. Kuwait’s economy is expected to contract 8.1% this year, as the Iran war disrupted energy shipments through the effective closure of the Strait of Hormuz, damaged energy production facilities, and reduced traffic, affecting tourism and business across the Gulf region.

US 10-Year Yield Rises to 19-Year High — The yield on the 10-year US Treasury note rose to above 5.01% on Wednesday, the highest in 19 years, after the Federal Reserve raised interest rates by 25bps. The move was largely expected by financial markets after recent data pointed to high inflation, low unemployment, and strong consumer spending. Projections by FOMC members pointed to one or two additional rate hikes by next year, consistent with upward revisions to forecasts on inflation and downward revisions to unemployment. Besides higher inflation due to soaring energy prices, the Chairman Warsh also acknowledged that Treasuries have been pressured by competing for capital allocation with soaring corporate debt supply. Still, longer-term maturities rose less than the shorter part of the curve as confidence that the Fed unanimously raised rates to fight inflation restored some credibility for the central bank, after Chairman Warsh had earlier downplayed the urgency of a higher funds rate to reign in price growth.

Oman Central Bank Raises Key Interest Rate — The Central Bank of Oman (CBO) raised its key repo rate by 25 bps to 4.50% in September 2026, mirroring the Federal Reserve’s decision. The move followed the Fed’s announcement that it would raise the target range for the federal funds rate by 25 bps to 3.75%-4%, while a majority of FOMC members projected another hike this year. If the Fed raises rates as expected this week, attention will be on whether Wosh views energy- and tariff-driven inflation as one-off supply shocks or as more persistent/second-round/expectations-driven pressure—emphasizing the former would reduce perceived need for further tightening, the latter would elevate tightening risk. Reuters flags political sensitivity: Trump has pushed for cuts while markets expect hikes; watch Wosh’s response to Trump, whether he reasserts FOMC independence, avoids naming Trump, or stresses “data dependence.” Wosh has tended to avoid forward-rate guidance; after July’s confusion and a hawkish turn at Jackson Hole, markets will watch for any change in messaging or a renewed insistence he has “no tolerance” for inflation. With the 10-year Treasury yield above 5% on Sept. 14, traders will also look for any comments addressing further bond sell-offs and concerns about fiscal- or inflation-related risk premia.

US 10-Year Yield Holds Pullback from 19-Year High — The yield on the 10-year US Treasury note eased to 4.95% on Wednesday from the 19-year high of 5.01% in the previous session after the Federal Reserve raised interest rates by 25bps, as expected. The move was largely expected by financial markets after evidence of high inflation in tandem with a robust labor market and retail sales aligned with Chairman Warsh's Jackson Hole signal that borrowing costs would be raised to combat price growth. Median projections by FOMC members pointed to split expectations of one or two additional rate hikes by next year, consistent with upward revisions to forecasts on inflation and downward revisions to unemployment. The yield on the longer-end of the curve eased more than the front end with the signal that the Fed heeds to higher prices. Still, yields on the 10-year note are 80bps higher since the start of the year. The impact of soaring energy inflation magnified pressure from soaring corporate debt supply and widening budget deficits.

The S&P 500 added 0.4% and the Nasdaq 100 gained 1%, while the Dow inched below the flatline. The Fed raised rates by 25bps, as expected, and median projections by FOMC members showed one or two additional hikes expected for this year as inflation is due to remain high and unemployment is expected to remain low. Chip producers and hardware companies extended yesterday's rebound after concerns over AI safety risks voiced by Anthropic and OpenAI jeopardized the momentum of soaring hyperscaler capital expenditure. Intel, Marvell, and Dell gained over 5%, while Nvidia and AMD were 3% higher. In turn, banks, retail, and pharmaceutical companies were mostly higher.

Fed Raises Rates for 1st Time Since 2023 — The Fed unanimously raised the target range for the federal funds rate by 25bps to 3.75%-4.00% in September 2026 as expected, marking the first rate hike since 2023. Policymakers noted that inflation remains elevated, and the move aims to support a more timely return to the 2% target. Updated projections showed that 16 of 18 officials see the possibility of at least one more 25bps rate hike later this year. Chair Warsh again declined to submit his forecasts. Meanwhile, the GDP is seen expanding at a slightly faster pace in 2026 (2.3% vs 2.2% in the June projection) and 2027 (2.4% vs 2.3%). PCE inflation is seen higher this year (3.7% vs 3.6%) but the forecast for 2027 was kept at 2.3%. Core inflation is also seen up in 2026 (3.4% vs 3.3%) but the forecast was left at 2.5% for 2027. The unemployment rate is now projected at 4.1% in both 2026 and 2027, down from the previous forecast of 4.3% for both years.

Meanwhile, EIA data showed US gasoline inventories unexpectedly rose for a second consecutive week, increasing by 800 thousand barrels in the week ending September 11th, as refineries continued to operate at elevated capacity, albeit at a slightly lower rate of 96.8%, while delaying non-essential work. However, the approaching seasonal fall maintenance remains a threat to refined-product supplies. The data also showed that demand increased by 300 thousand barrels per day, while pump prices continued to rise.

European Stocks Close Higher — European stocks closed higher on Wednesday, halting sharp losses from the week amid a pause on the recent rallies in energy prices and sovereign yields. The Euro STOXX rose 0.5% to 6,267 and the STOXX Europe 600 rose 0.5% to 637. Inflationary risks in the Euro Area remained rampant and the elevated levels for sovereign yields continued to dampen credit conditions, but the pause in the slump for bonds allowed equities to enjoy some respite. Allianz, BNP Paribas, and AXA added over 1% to support the financial sector while ASML and Infineon advanced 1.3% on a strong session for AI infrastructure stocks. The Federal Reserve was due to hike its rates by 25bps after the closing bell, and a fragmented FOMC is expected to pencil a wide range of projections for the US economy in their SEP.

Colombia Industrial Acitivty Falls Most Since 2025 — Colombia’s industrial production declined 2.3% year-on-year in July 2026, marking the sharpest decline since April 2025 and reversing a 4.1% gain in the previous month. The reading was well below market expectations of a 0.4% contraction, as production declined in 27 of 32 industries, including the manufacture of clothing (-14.1%), processing of meat (-8.1%), basic iron and steel (-12.6%), spinning, weaving and finishing of textiles (-17.9%), and cocoa, chocolate and confectionery (-19.2%). Meanwhile, output rose in the manufacture of soaps and detergents (8.8%) and beverages (2.3%). Real sales declined 1.8%, while employment also fell 1.4%.

FTSE 100 Edges Up on Wednesday — The FTSE 100 rose 0.3% on Wednesday after falling 0.4% in the previous session, as easing oil prices supported sentiment despite a fresh rise in UK inflation. Consumer prices increased 3.1% year-on-year in August, up from 2.9% in July and matching market expectations, although above the Bank of England’s 2.8% forecast. Higher motor-fuel prices, linked to the ongoing Iran conflict, and increased airfares contributed to the acceleration. Markets are now focused on the Federal Reserve’s decision later today and the Bank of England’s meeting on Thursday. Barratt Redrow surged more than 11% after reporting stronger-than-expected annual results, while Persimmon gained 6%. Banks including Standard Chartered, NatWest, Lloyds Banking Group and HSBC all rose after JPMorgan forecast stronger third-quarter trading and investment-banking revenue. On the other hand, energy majors Shell and BP fell more than 2% each.

巴克萊銀行：預計沃什會強調經濟增長穩健、就業接近充分就業，且通脹水平依舊過高，大體延續此前偏鷹派的表態。

高盛：預計沃什會強調審慎評估新增經濟資料，或等待多份通脹報告出爐後，再決定下一步政策動作。
摩根大通：預計政策細節披露有限，但相比以往釋出會，沃什或將更加側重經濟資料。
野村證券：預計不會給出下一步政策的明確指引，政策走向將高度依賴月度通脹資料。
渣打銀行：市場會重點審視關稅與通脹問題，關注關稅帶來的影響是否為暫時性，以及美聯儲是否應當等待更明確證據後再進一步收緊政策。
道明銀行：認為如果美聯儲今日加息，後續大機率還有緊縮動作，沃什將面臨較大溝通壓力。
瑞銀：預計前瞻指引內容不多，但加息這一行為本身，會增強沃什鷹派言論的說服力。

【Diamond Hill: Unclear rate outlook justifies buying short-term bonds】Diamond Hill analyst Henry Song says bond-market uncertainty warrants allocating to short-term assets with attractive yields. He expects today's Fed decision will do little to alter war-driven inflation, leaving the rate outlook unclear, and calls Treasury Secretary BESSENT's efforts to control long yields futile because the market "has seen through his bluff." Song's strategy is to buy "large amounts of high-current-yield short-term assets" and stay flexible to redeploy proceeds at maturity if rates rise, saying "it's like a dance: maintain portfolio yield while preserving optionality."

Colombia Retail Sales Growth Slows in July — Colombia’s real retail sales rose 5.3% year over year in July 2026, missing forecasts for an 11.2% increase and slowing from 14.7% growth in June. This marked the slowest growth since September 2024. Fourteen merchandise lines recorded increases in real sales, while five declined. The largest positive contributions came from motor vehicles and motorcycles, mainly for household use (21.8%), other motor vehicles and motorcycles (10.8%), and sound and video equipment and devices (25%). Declines in vehicle fuel sales (-3.6%), spare parts, components, accessories and lubricants for vehicles, mainly for household consumption (-2%), clothing and textiles (-3%), pharmaceutical and medicinal products (-0.7%), and footwear, leather goods and leather substitutes (-0.2%) limited overall retail growth.

The bank still forecasts a 25bp hike but warns the Fed risks undermining market confidence in further tightening because markets have over‑priced policy tightening for next year. Foley said the dollar could weaken in the near term, but a large sell‑off is unlikely given external vulnerabilities elsewhere — notably limited UK fiscal space and the euro area’s status as an energy importer. Colombia Consumer Confidence Falls in August — Colombia’s Consumer Confidence Index fell 5.2 percentage points to 15.5% in August 2026 from July. The decline was driven by a 7.7-point drop in the Consumer Expectations Index to 22.6% and a 1.6-point decrease in the Economic Conditions Index to 4.8%. Consumer expectations deteriorated as households’ assessment of their economic outlook fell to 36.4% from 41.8%, while general expectations for the economy declined to 16.7% from 24.8%. The outlook for the country’s economy fell to 14.8% from 24.3%. Meanwhile, households’ assessment of current economic conditions declined to 5.4% from 11.1%. Willingness to buy durable goods increased to 4.2% from 1.7%. Compared with August 2025, the Consumer Confidence Index increased by 17.9 percentage points.

Brent Crude Falls Toward $106 — Brent crude fell to around $106 a barrel on Wednesday, extending its retreat after two sessions of gains as the US administration sought to ease concerns over disruptions to Saudi oil supplies. US Energy Secretary Chris Wright said Saudi Arabia’s damaged East-West pipeline should resume operations within days, describing the outage as temporary. However, independent analysts warned that repairs could take several weeks. While the pipeline remains offline, Saudi Arabia has moved to increase crude exports through the Strait of Hormuz with US military assistance. Meanwhile, US government data showed crude inventories fell by 640,000 barrels to 423.4 million barrels in the week ended September 11, although the decline was smaller than analysts had expected. Stocks at the Cushing, Oklahoma, hub also decreased. The data contrasted sharply with the American Petroleum Institute’s previous estimate of a 7.1 million-barrel increase in crude inventories.

【贖回擠兌加劇 土耳其股市熔斷】週三，土耳其股市大幅下挫，伊斯坦布林證券交易所100指數盤中下跌6%，觸發市場熔斷機制。其中，主要銀行指數下跌7.7%。據金融資料平臺Fintables資料，週三，投資者從土耳其投資基金中淨贖回550億里拉（約合11.3億美元）。此次拋售發生在Pusula Portfoy（普蘇拉投資組合管理公司，土耳其本土持牌資產管理公司）週二宣佈其部分投資基金和貨幣市場基金無法滿足贖回請求之後。資料顯示，自8月底以來，投資者已從Pusula Portfoy旗下基金撤出約1290億里拉（27億美元）。這輪贖回擠兌，發生在土耳其資本市場委員會限制重倉流動性較差股票的基金之後，這給Pusula滿足贖回要求帶來壓力。BVeri諮詢公司創始人及經濟學家Banu Kivci Tokali表示，市場對基金抵押品穩健性和流動性的擔憂日益加劇，這似乎增加了其他基金和公司也可能面臨困境的風險。可以說，該行業信心喪失的加劇在市場拋售潮的湧現中起到了重要作用。（券商中國）

【OpenAI tests advertiser-facing AI tools】OpenAI said on Wednesday it has launched advertiser-facing AI tools and begun testing company-sponsored chatbots for user interaction to expand into the AI-driven marketing market. A sponsored agents feature will let users converse with company-sponsored agents inside ChatGPT and, after interacting with an ad, access the sponsor's website; agents will be clearly labeled and segregated from ChatGPT's independent replies and users' original chats. The feature is being piloted with select US advertisers. Separately, a ChatGPT Ads Manager plugin will let advertisers use natural-language prompts to create, update and analyze campaigns—converting websites or campaign briefs into campaigns, reviewing performance and providing recommendations, including copy and image suggestions based on landing pages and campaign objectives.

Ecuador Trade Balance Swings to Surplus — Ecuador recorded a trade surplus of $504.4 million in July 2026, reversing a $257.0 million deficit in July 2025. Exports reached $3.72 billion, increasing 48.5% year-on-year. Non-oil exports totaled $2.91 billion, up 25.0%, while shrimp exports reached $1.0 billion, rising 64.4%. Mining products totaled $545.3 million, up 59.4%. Imports reached $3.21 billion, increasing 16.4%, with fuels and lubricants recording the strongest growth, at 35.4%. Ecuador posted a $2.84 billion trade surplus between January and July 2026.

【湖北恩施通報“主播假冒村幹部直播帶貨”：已立案調查】9月16日，湖北恩施市市場監督管理局釋出情況通報：近日，有媒體報道註冊地在我市的湖北天企盈文化傳媒有限公司運營的直播賬號，涉嫌假冒村幹部身份進行直播帶貨。獲悉相關資訊後，我局第一時間組建工作專班開展調查核實工作。經初步核查，該公司所涉4名主播運營的7個直播賬號，使用“村支書”“村長”等暱稱，虛擬“下鄉”場景，吸引關注，增加流量，開展直播帶貨，涉嫌虛假宣傳，誤導消費者。我局依據《中華人民共和國反不正當競爭法》相關規定，已對該公司及4名涉事主播依法立案調查，案件正在辦理中。

【美國住宅建築商信心降至一年低點 借貸成本高企持續拖累樓市】美國住宅建築商信心本月大幅下滑至一年來最低水平，接近7%的抵押貸款利率、勞動力短缺以及材料成本上漲，進一步打擊了美國低迷住房市場的復甦希望。美國全國住宅建築商協會（NAHB）和富國銀行公佈的資料顯示，住宅市場指數下降3點至32，為2025年9月以來最低，並追平2022年底以來最低水平。該指數也低於彭博調查經濟學家所得的34的預估中值。指數低於50意味著認為市場狀況不佳的建築商多於認為狀況良好的建築商，該指數已經連續逾兩年低於這一水平。除了購房者看房活動疲弱外，“建築商還繼續面臨材料成本上升、汽油和柴油價格上漲以及持續的勞動力短缺，”NAHB主席、俄亥俄州住宅建築商Bill Owens在事先準備的宣告中表示。“一些市場的建築商反映，移民執法力度的加強正導致合法工人不願前往工地報到。”該指數的分項指標中，未來銷售預期指標降至2023年初以來最低水平，當前銷售指標也下滑。潛在買家客流指標維持在低位不變。這種低迷的前景反映出美國住宅建築商面臨的挑戰。在潛在購房者從高昂借貸成本中獲得一些緩解之前，幾乎看不到能夠扭轉局面的催化因素。消費者信心處於有記錄以來最低水平之一，也降低了市場出現轉機的可能性。

【“暗網”報告出爐：首個AI攻擊智慧體已在售，商業航天等成為攻擊物件】9月16日，國家計算機病毒應急處理中心釋出《暗網監測2025年度報告》，報告依託對10萬餘個暗網節點的動態監測，系統梳理我國及全球暗網威脅事件、資料販賣、重大攻擊活動和黑產生態演化，並對2026年風險走向提出預判，由國家計算機病毒應急處理中心、西安交通大學網路空間安全學院、中國大唐集團有限公司、陝西省公安廳科技資訊化總隊、泓理信安（陝西）網路科技有限責任公司、盛邦安全科技集團等17家來自監管、高校、關鍵基礎設施企業不同領域的權威機構聯合編寫。研究機構盛邦安全認為，AI工具的使用促進“暗網”完成迭代，過去以單一經濟牟利為目的的供給部分轉向了戰略破壞與地緣博弈，參與主體也從零散駭客升級為國家背景的作戰力量和有組織的跨國犯罪集團，AI自動化供給正在替代傳統人工滲透。報告同時提醒，由於黑產服務化以及智慧化的趨勢，攻擊門檻不斷降低，一些新興產業受攻擊的風險不斷升高，如商業航天、衛星通訊等新型資產，正在進入暗網交易與攻擊視野。（科技日報）

【Guyuelongshan: High-end huangjiu channel margins and low-alcohol health trend are attracting distributors】Sept. 16 — China's huangjiu sector rallied. Kuaijishan jumped to a second straight daily limit-up, closing at 28.33 yuan, while Guyuelongshan and Jinfeng Wine also hit limit-up. Market chatter says large baijiu distributors are increasingly seeking national agency roles in huangjiu, fuelling expectations of the category expanding beyond Zhejiang. Guyuelongshan confirmed that, amid an adjustment in the baijiu sector and narrowing channel margins for some products, high-quality distributors are looking for new categories; higher channel margins for high-end huangjiu and a low-alcohol, health-focused consumption trend are making the category attractive.

【廣東湛江海警查獲涉嫌走私香菸2萬餘條 案值逾千萬】2026年9月12日晚，湛江海警局接到報警稱，廉江市龍頭沙對開海域有一艘大馬力快艇形跡可疑，疑似正在進行走私活動。該局迅速派廉江工作站執法艇趕赴目標海域，並聯合湛江海警局和廉江市公安局、廉江市菸草專賣局進行綜合研判，從海陸雙向布控。海警執法員抵達現場後，採取隱蔽抵近的方式精準鎖定嫌疑船舶，準備登臨制控，船上2名涉案人員察覺後，當即棄船跳海逃竄，最終因體力不支被當場抓獲。現場查獲改裝大馬力快艇1艘，香菸2萬餘條，案值1110餘萬元，均無法提供該批香菸合法手續，涉嫌走私，執法員依法將涉案船舶及貨物押回作進一步調查。（央視新聞）

Conversely, the supramax index rose by 0.7% to 1,748 points.

Year-on-year, business inventories grew by 3.8%.

Oil prices fell amid signs of rising US inventories and reports that Saudi Arabia is offering additional crude cargoes via Oman. Meanwhile, yields retreated after a global rally in recent weeks weighed on equity markets, as investors fear central banks will keep monetary policy tighter for longer to tame inflationary pressures from soaring energy prices. Major banks edged above the flatline. Gold prices climbed ahead of the Fed’s decision later today, with Agnico Eagle rising nearly 2.5%, while Barrick and WPM gained about 2% each. Elsewhere, European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen said the EU is opening the door for Canada to become its first “associate member,” with cooperation across sectors including manufacturing, AI, critical minerals and energy. This follows an escalation in the US-Canada trade war after trade talks collapsed last month.

Silver Gains Ahead of Fed Rate Decision — Silver prices rose more than 1% to around $64.50 an ounce on Wednesday, as oil prices eased after a two-day rally while investors awaited the US Federal Reserve’s upcoming interest-rate decision for further direction. The Fed is widely expected to raise interest rates for the first time since 2023, with markets pricing in more than a 90% probability of at least a 25-basis-point hike, according to the CME FedWatch Tool. The move could be the first of two rate increases projected for the year, as persistent inflation and heightened tensions in the Middle East add to concerns over rising costs. Meanwhile, several other major central banks are scheduled to announce policy decisions this week. The Bank of Japan is expected to raise interest rates to their highest level in 31 years on Friday, while the Bank of England is widely expected to keep rates unchanged on Thursday, although the decision remains a close call.

In contrast, the US Fed is expected to announce a 25bps rate hike later in the day, its first since 2023. The decision is being driven by persistently high inflation and rising global financing costs. Financials traded lower, with Banco do Brasil falling 2% and Bradesco shedding more than 0.5%. Petrobras fell more than 1% as oil prices retreated amid signs of rising US inventories and reports that Saudi Arabia is offering additional crude cargoes via Oman. Other notable laggards included Ambev and WEG, both down about 1%.

US Stocks Halt Pullback Ahead of Fed — US stocks inched higher on Wednesday, pausing the week's pullback as markets assessed how the economy may fare against higher interest rates. The S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 rose 0.3% from six-week lows yesterday, and the Dow was flat. The Federal Reserve is expected to raise interest rates by 25bps later in the meeting, although the Summary of Economic Projections is likely to show a fragmented FOMC as uncertain outlooks spark disagreements on policy and forward guidance. Hawkish concerns were further consolidated with the release of strong retail sales and soaring import inflation. Chip producers and hardware companies extended yesterday's rebound after concerns over AI safety risks voiced by Anthropic and OpenAI jeopardized the momentum of soaring hyperscaler capital expenditure. Intel, Marvell, and Dell gained over 3%. In turn, banks, retail, and pharmaceutical companies were flat.

Treasury Yields Edge Down, Fed Awaited — The yield on the US 10-year Treasury note edged down to 4.97% on Wednesday, taking a breather after surging for five consecutive sessions to breach 5.04% on Tuesday, its highest level since July 2007. Investors are now bracing for the Fed’s policy decision later in the day. The central bank is widely expected to raise borrowing costs by 25bps, which would mark its first rate hike since 2023. Markets are currently pricing in roughly a 93% probability of such a move, with another ihike expected in December. A dip in oil prices also offered some temporary relief from inflationary pressures. Treasury yields have been rising amid higher oil prices, which are likely to fuel inflation and prompt tighter monetary policy, as well as concerns over elevated US fiscal deficits. On Tuesday, Treasury Secretary Bessent attributed the rise in bond yields to “global issues” and told lawmakers during his congressional hearing that the need to address the government deficit was another factor weighing.

【蘋果考慮重返伺服器市場，已與英偉達洽談採用其網路技術】知情人士稱，蘋果一直在推進自研晶片企業伺服器的相關規劃，這款伺服器或將搭載英偉達的網路裝置。這家 Mac 製造商希望藉此抓住市場對其 AI 電腦需求激增的機遇。訊息人士表示，蘋果正在研發該伺服器，計劃面向 AI 開發者、其他企業以及政府客戶銷售。目前考量的產品包含兩個版本：小型版本整合兩顆蘋果規劃中的 M8 Ultra 晶片組成叢集；大型版本搭載四顆 M8 Ultra 晶片。M 系列 Ultra 是蘋果效能最強的晶片，Mac Studio 等產品均採用該系列晶片。知情人士稱，蘋果考慮採用英偉達一套名為 NVLink Fusion 的產品，實現伺服器內 M8 晶片之間的互聯。這套產品包含交換機、小晶片以及配套軟體，用於資料中心內晶片間通訊。若合作落地，將進一步緩和兩大科技巨頭長期冷淡的關係，雙方關係近期才初現回暖跡象。按照當前預期，這款蘋果產品最快 2029 年才會上市，專案仍存在終止的可能性，也可能在不採用英偉達技術的前提下繼續推進。部分知情人士透露，本月初剛上任的蘋果新任執行長約翰・特納斯，大約一年前在執掌蘋果硬體工程部門時，就已是該專案的支持者。

【富創精密：兩名股東擬合計減持不超2%公司股份】富創精密公告稱，公司持股8.80%的股東泰州祥浦創業投資基金合夥企業（有限合夥）、持股8.39%的股東國投（上海）科技成果轉化創業投資基金企業（有限合夥），因自身資金安排需要，擬透過集中競價方式各減持不超過3,062,107股公司股份，各佔公司總股本的1%，合計減持比例不超過2%。減持期間為2026年10月19日至2027年1月18日，減持價格按市場價格確定，若公司發生股本除權除息事項，減持數量將相應調整。本次減持不會導致公司控制權變更，減持數量、時間和價格存在不確定性。

【海南省委書記馮飛會見高通公司全球副總裁夏權一行】據海南日報客戶端，9月15日，海南省委書記馮飛在海口會見前來參加博鰲亞洲論壇亞太區域合作圓桌的高通公司全球副總裁夏權一行。馮飛表示，海南自由貿易港啟動全島封關運作以來，政策紅利持續釋放、開放活力持續顯現，為廣大企業來海南投資興業創造了廣闊空間。海南正著力打造具有特色和優勢的現代化產業體系，在種業、深海科技、商業航天、清潔能源、數字經濟等方面具有豐富的特色應用場景。希望充分發揮高通公司綜合優勢，用好自由貿易港開放政策和場景優勢，找準雙方在人工智慧賦能產業發展、熱帶汽車測試等領域合作切入點，促進科技創新和產業創新深度融合，推動形成務實成果，實現互利共贏發展。夏權表示，高通公司非常看好海南發展前景，雙方在多個產業發展方向上高度契合，在助力中國車企出海、算力應用、具身智慧、6G應用等領域合作潛力巨大；願加強交流對接，共同推動相關產業發展；將發揮牽線搭橋作用，推動優質企業和專案落地，為海南自由貿易港建設貢獻力量。
【藥明生物商業化高階製造平臺專案在無錫簽約落地】9月16日，藥明生物商業化高階製造平臺專案在無錫簽約落地。專案包括佈局新型生物製劑生產線和配套工藝開發實驗室，產品管線覆蓋單克隆抗體、雙特異性抗體、Fc融合蛋白等前沿生物製劑品類。

Belarus Industrial Growth Edges Higher — Belarus’ industrial production edged up 0.2% year-on-year in the first eight months of 2026, following a 0.1% increase in the first seven months. Growth was supported by a 7.5% increase in electricity, gas, steam, hot water and air-conditioning supply, while mining and quarrying output rose 2.7%. Water supply, waste management and remediation activities increased 1.6%. However, manufacturing output contracted 1%, limiting gains in other sectors and remaining in contraction for more than a year.
